We are looking for a Strategic Marketing Manager to drive thought leadership and market presence for SES's Energy, Medical Devices, and Consumer Products business unit. This role builds SES's technical credibility and visibility within the EMD verticals through published research, technical journal placements, and strategic industry association partnerships, while serving as the embedded marketing partner to the EMD BU leader. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role. You'll set the EMD thought leadership and marketing strategy, then personally execute it, writing the pitch, building the campaign, designing the graphic. There is no team to delegate to.

Thought Leadership & Industry Presence

Build and execute a thought leadership strategy across Energy, Medical Devices, and Consumer Products, positioning SES engineers as recognized technical authorities
Personally research, write, and pitch submissions to technical and trade journals relevant to each EMD sub-vertical

Develop and execute vertical-specific go-to-market strategies across the three EMD sub-verticals

Build and launch EMD campaigns end-to-end in Microsoft Dynamics 365, strategy, setup, execution, and reporting

Stress Engineering Services (SES) is an elite, one-of-a-kind engineering consulting firm, trusted for more than 50 years to solve the problems others can’t. Our reputation is built on an uncompromising commitment to technical excellence, a highly selective team of experts, and a track record of delivering answers in the most complex, high-stakes environments. We operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real-world application, partnering with clients across energy, aerospace, consumer products, medical, and beyond. Our teams combine advanced analysis with hands-on testing, failure analysis, and practical engineering judgment to deliver solutions that perform where it matters most, in the field. As an employee-owned company, our people are personally invested in every outcome, creating a culture where accountability is high and excellence is the standard. We don’t just solve problems, we uncover root causes, mitigate risk, and deliver confidence.

For our clients, that means a trusted partner known for rigor and results. For our people, it means joining an elite team tackling the most meaningful challenges in engineering.

SES is where complex problems meet uncommon solutions and where elite engineers come to do their best work.

We Over Me – We put the mission, our clients, and our team ahead of individual agendas
Unyielding Pursuit of Excellence – Excellence is the standard. We deliver the right solution, on time, every time
Own It – We take accountability to earn trust and deliver results

Solve problems that matter – Your work directly impacts product performance, safety, and reliability
High autonomy + high ownership – You’re trusted to lead and deliver
Broad technical exposure – Work across industries, materials, and challenges
Collaborate with experts – Learn from recognized leaders in engineering and failure analysis
Entrepreneurial environment – Be part of a team that values initiative, curiosity, and innovation
Employee-owned culture (ESOP) – Share in the success you help create

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect deep technical understanding with positioning, distribution and commercial results. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire.

A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck. So can a precise message that reaches a developer at the moment they are deciding how to build.

You'll work across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Sales and Marketing to bring those pieces together. You'll help shape what we launch, how we explain it, how buyers discover it and how our field teams take it to market.

What You'll Build

A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable.
Solutions people can actually use. Drive the packaging of sample apps, reference architectures, integrations, templates and working demos that prove what the infrastructure makes possible. Build repeatable plays for use cases such as contact centers, agent assist and industry-specific workflows. These should accelerate adoption and enterprise sales, not become disconnected software products.
Distribution that reaches technical buyers. Shape how we win discovery through product pages, developer content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), technical communities and paid acquisition. You won't necessarily operate every campaign, but you must understand the mechanics deeply enough to direct them: search and answer-engine visibility, technical site structure, intent, targeting, conversion paths, attribution and economics.
A field-ready commercial engine. Give enterprise sellers, FDEs and solutions teams the pitches, discovery frameworks, architecture diagrams, competitive proof, demos and ROI narratives they need to generate and advance opportunities. Translate platform capabilities into buying reasons for developers, technical executives and enterprise decision-makers.
Launches that translate into adoption. Work with Product and Engineering early, not after something ships. Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap.
An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way.

How We'll Measure Success

The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results.

Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake.

What We're Looking For

You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work.
You are technically fluent. You can understand architecture, work with APIs or SDKs, interrogate a latency or cost claim and talk comfortably with engineers. You don't have to be a production engineer, but you need to know when a demo is real and when it's just a pitch.
You understand modern technical acquisition. You're credible directing AEO, SEO, paid programs and developer-focused content, and can connect channel-level metrics to funnel economics and qualified pipeline.
You're already effective with AI tools and agents in your own work. You experiment, build workflows and use the technology to move faster. Familiarity with the limitations and evaluation of AI-generated outputs is as important as enthusiasm for the tools.
You write exceptionally well, have strong instincts for enterprise sales, and know how to turn a complex product advantage into a clear reason to buy.
You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders.

Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more.

Why Telnyx

This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth.

Equal opportunity

Telnyx is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on the skills and experience relevant to the role.

Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Samsung Electronics America, Inc. (SEA), the U.S. Sales and Marketing subsidiary, is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. For more than four decades, Samsung has driven innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity across the United States—investing over $100 billion and employing more than 20,000 people nationwide. By integrating our large portfolio of products, services and AI technology, we’re creating smarter, sustainable and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. SEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager of B2B CRM & Marketing Automation to lead the evolution of our digital customer engagement, marketing automation, and lead management capabilities. This role will help architect the digital demand journey—connecting media, content, web experiences, lead capture, marketing automation, CRM, and sales activation into an integrated B2B growth engine. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong operational expertise and understands how digital experiences work together to attract prospects, capture demand, nurture relationships, identify buying signals, and ultimately generate pipeline.

This leader will partner closely with Sales, Integrated Marketing, Digital, Creative, Analytics, Product Marketing, Technology, and external partners to develop scalable customer journeys that improve engagement, strengthen marketing-to-sales connectivity, and deliver measurable business impact. This is an opportunity for a builder—someone who can optimize today’s programs while helping design the capabilities, processes, technology, and customer experiences required to support future B2B growth.

Role And Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

CRM, Lifecycle & Customer Engagement Strategy

Participate in CRM Governance Council for planning and coordination across SEA lines of business. Ensure compliance with all guidelines and provide briefs and analysis for Council review.
Own and evolve the B2B CRM and marketing automation strategy across the customer engagement journey.
Develop scalable lifecycle and nurture strategies aligned to customer needs, buying stages, business priorities, and sales motions.
Build segmentation, personalization, and next-best-action approaches that increase customer relevance and accelerate progression through the funnel.
Identify gaps and opportunities across the customer journey and translate them into actionable programs, capabilities, and technology improvements.
Develop strategies for lead capture, qualification, scoring, routing, nurture, recycling, re-engagement, and sales activation.
Continuously explore new approaches to customer engagement, including emerging automation, AI, personalization, and journey orchestration capabilities.

Digital Customer Journey & Conversion Experience

Own and continuously improve the digital pathways that move B2B prospects from awareness and engagement through lead capture, nurture, sales engagement, and conversion.
Partner across Integrated Marketing, Digital, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, and Sales to develop connected experiences across websites, landing pages, digital advertising, content, email, events, and other customer touchpoints- translating campaign engagement into scalable nurture and conversion programs.
Develop and optimize high-performing landing pages, lead-capture experiences, calls-to-action, forms, and conversion pathways that translate marketing engagement into identifiable demand.
Use behavioral and conversion data to identify friction within the digital journey and recommend improvements to content, UX, personalization, navigation, conversion paths, and nurture experiences.
Partner with creative and content teams to identify the assets needed to support customer progression, including digital advertising, solution content, thought leadership, case studies, gated and ungated content, and sales enablement experiences.
Champion experimentation through A/B testing, personalization, dynamic content, progressive profiling, journey optimization, and emerging AI-enabled experiences.

Demand Generation & Pipeline Acceleration

Partner with Sales and Sales Operations to strengthen marketing-to-sales handoffs and improve lead follow-up, acceptance, conversion, and pipeline velocity.
Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and prioritize prospects based on fit, intent, engagement, and buying behavior.
Establish clear measurement frameworks connecting CRM and digital engagement programs to business outcomes including engagement, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline, conversion, and revenue.

Marketing Automation, Technology & Data

Serve as a business owner and subject matter expert for B2B marketing automation, CRM, lead management, and related customer engagement capabilities.
Translate business and customer requirements into scalable marketing technology solutions and workflows.
Partner with technology, analytics, and platform teams to improve integrations, data quality, audience management, campaign orchestration, identity resolution, and measurement.
Ensure customer and behavioral data can be effectively activated across marketing programs and surfaced to Sales where appropriate.
Evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities that can improve marketing effectiveness, customer experience, operational efficiency, and sales connectivity.
Establish governance, documentation, testing, quality assurance, and operational standards for CRM and automated marketing programs.

Analytics, Optimization & Innovation

Develop reporting and performance frameworks that provide actionable insights into customer behavior, funnel progression, campaign effectiveness, and pipeline contribution.
Use data and experimentation to continually improve engagement, conversion, customer experience, and business outcomes.
Establish test-and-learn roadmaps across messaging, segmentation, cadence, channel, personalization, landing experiences, and journey design.
Identify friction and leakage across the customer journey and develop recommendations to address them.
Bring forward emerging technologies, industry best practices, and innovative approaches that advance the organization’s B2B digital marketing maturity.
Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for marketing, digital, and sales stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as a strategic connector across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Digital, Creative, Analytics, Technology, Product Marketing, and other key stakeholders.
Translate complex business requirements into clear strategies, processes, and execution plans.
Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring coordination across multiple teams, platforms, and stakeholders.
Influence without direct authority and proactively drive decisions, accountability, and progress.
Establish clear roles and operating processes across teams involved in the digital customer journey.
Serve as an internal advocate for customer-centric, data-driven B2B marketing practices.

Agency, Vendor & Contract Management

Manage agency, technology, and vendor relationships supporting CRM, marketing automation, digital customer experiences, data, and related programs.
Own or support scopes of work, contract development, renewals, procurement processes, budgets, and vendor performance.
Establish clear KPIs, deliverables, and service expectations for external partners and hold partners accountable for performance.
Evaluate existing and prospective partners based on capability, scalability, performance, cost, and alignment with future business needs.
Identify opportunities to improve partner models, consolidate capabilities, increase efficiency, or introduce new expertise as business needs evolve.

Demonstrated experience developing customer journeys and marketing programs that contribute to lead generation, pipeline, and revenue growth.
Strong understanding of complex B2B buying journeys, demand generation, lead management, sales funnels, and digital conversion.
Experience with enterprise CRM and marketing automation platforms and familiarity with the broader marketing technology ecosystem.
Understanding of digital experience fundamentals including landing pages, conversion optimization, web journeys, forms, content strategy, digital media, and UX principles.

Team player and ability to collaborate with cross- functional stakeholders for best outcomes

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description

Marketing at Gensler is where strong marketers become great ones, and the Marketing Coordinator role is where that arc begins. We're looking for a candidate who is ready to take on real ownership, learn fast, and grow inside one of the largest, most experienced marketing teams in the industry, someone whose curiosity, instincts, and skillset are starting to outpace their current role.

Our marketers are valued not only for what they produce, but for what they bring to the table: the questions they ask, the ideas they raise, the relationships they build, and the way they sharpen how we tell our story. The Marketing Coordinator role is where those instincts start to take shape, alongside the production fluency, design judgment, and strategic thinking that define a strong marketer.

As a Marketing Coordinator in our Work sector, you will partner with senior marketers, principals, designers, and strategists on pursuits across financial services, professional services, legal, technology, media, and other workplace-driven industries for some of the most influential organizations in New York and beyond.

This role is part producer, part collaborator, part student of the craft. You will own the start-to-end production of marketing collateral and proposal sections, contribute to pursuit planning, and learn directly from marketers who shape how Gensler competes.

You will work with a global network of marketers, based out of the largest design office in the world, with access to Gensler's research and thought leadership platforms — including the firm's Workplace Survey and global benchmarking data — to ground your work in real insight. The work is fast-paced and rarely the same twice: a flagship financial services headquarters one week, a global media campus the next, an AI hub the week after.

As you progress, you will develop the strategic instincts, design fluency, production rigor, and relationship range to move from supporting pursuits to helping shape them.

You'll join one of the firm's most experienced marketing teams supporting work across 33 practice areas. The team brings a high level of craft, rigor, and generosity to the work. You ask smart questions, raise your hand when you need help, and just as readily raise it when you see a way to make something better. You're curious about new tools and techniques, alert to where technology can give the team an edge and are energized by figuring out smarter ways to work.

This isn't a fit for someone content to stay in a narrow production lane. It's a fit for someone who wants to grow into a real marketing leader.

What You Will Do

Contribution to pursuit planning and win strategy conversations
Multiple parallel projects and deadlines, with the discipline to manage them without sacrificing quality
Marketing resources — resumes, case stories, project libraries — kept current, accurate, and trusted
Deep familiarity with Gensler's portfolio, practice areas, and firm-wide capabilities
Special projects that elevate the quality of our marketing output

Your Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Journalism, Business, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field

Excellent written and verbal communication
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines
Learning mindset — curious about emerging tools and technologies, open to new ways of working, and motivated to keep growing

Your cover letter should address the key characteristics highlighted in this position description and communicate why your skillset, experience, and background make you a strong fit for this role.

Life at Gensler

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Awareness Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

Partner with regional sales leaders across the country to agree on target accounts, priorities, and a shared definition of success for each territory.
Manage the Americas program budget, allocating spend across territories based on pipeline opportunity and program performance.

Run a high-impact event portfolio

Plan and execute executive dinners, roundtables, and roadshows in key markets e.g., New York, Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta, Bay Area, Washington DC, building a repeatable format that can run in multiple cities each quarter.
Handle end-to-end logistics across multiple simultaneous events, using agencies and vendors where needed to scale execution.

Activate partners

Work with the global partner marketing team to plan and run joint programs with technology partners, HCM platform partners, and systems integrators.

What success looks like

First 90 days:
You know the Americas sales leaders, top target accounts, and key partners in each territory, and you've launched your first multi-city programs.
First 6 months:
You own the Americas plan with pipeline targets by territory and a repeatable event and ABM playbook running in priority markets.
First 12 months:
Field marketing is a measurable, trusted source of pipeline in every territory, and sales leaders nationwide see you as a strategic partner.

Must-haves

5+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or ABM experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology, including ownership of a national or multi-region territory.
Experience managing multiple events at once across different cities, including working with agencies and vendors to scale.
Ability to travel 40 to 50% of the time.

Experience managing or mentoring event coordinators, contractors, or agency teams.

We believe in providing transparency and support so you can do the best work of your career.

At Eightfold, we believe our best work happens when we collaborate closely, learn from one another, and build together. We follow a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with a strong emphasis on in-person collaboration to foster innovation, culture, and rapid execution.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Content Marketing team is evolving into a Content Center of Excellence (CoE) that earns market authority through deep topic ownership, original research, and AI-powered workflows. We are looking for a Content Marketing Manager who will sit at the intersection of thought leadership, research, and AI innovation — someone who doesn't just write great content but builds the systems and AI workflows that scale great content across Snowflake.

Our ideal candidate is deeply curious, a strong writer and editor, obsessed with AI tooling, and energized by the idea of building repeatable AI workflows that turn a brief into a publish-ready asset. Write and edit high-quality content across formats: research reports, ebooks, solution briefs, blog posts, web pages, executive bylines, and campaign assets

Comfort with data tools and willingness to learn Snowflake-specific platforms (Cortex, Streamlit, SQL basics) — you don't need to be an engineer, but you should be eager to build

jobs.description:
About the Company

WHEN Justice is a crowdsourcing platform democratizing litigation funding. We enable the public to directly fund strategic litigation that protects the environment, strengthens food safety standards, and defends consumer rights. Our mission is to hold accountable those who put power and profit before people, communities, and the planet we share. Unlike traditional legal advocacy organizations, our model puts the public at the center. Ordinary people fund the cases, follow their progress, and see the real-world impact of holding powerful actors accountable. Growing that community of backers is how we take on more cases, sustain them longer, and win.

About the Role

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Lead to build and scale the engine that brings people to WHEN Justice, turns them into backers, and keeps them coming back. This is a hands-on role for someone who runs experiments quickly, measures them honestly, and uses AI to do work that would usually take a full team. Each case we launch is effectively a new product, with its own story, audience, and funding goal. Your job is to build a repeatable launch playbook: find the right audiences, test the message, convert interest into funding, and turn first-time backers into people who support case after case. You will tie campaigns to real case milestones, such as filings, rulings, and settlements, so our community grows alongside the work. Our cases are active litigation, so accuracy is not optional. Every claim in an ad, email, or landing page has to be true and defensible. You will work closely with our attorneys, and we expect you to treat legal review as part of the craft, not friction. Trust is the product. We are looking for someone with the judgment to grow fast without cutting corners. We are a lean organization, and AI sits at the center of this role. We expect you to build real workflows, not just use a chatbot: creative and copy variation pipelines, audience segmentation, lifecycle personalization, prospect and partner research, and content built to surface in AI-driven search as well as traditional search. The Growth Marketing Lead reports to the Executive Director and works closely with legal, communications, development, and our product and engineering partners.

Responsibilities

Own the full growth funnel, from first visit through first contribution, repeat support, and referral
Design and run a steady cadence of experiments across channels, creative, landing pages, and lifecycle messaging, with sound test design and clear decision rules
Build and maintain event tracking, analytics, and dashboards, and write your own queries to get answers
Measure true incrementality through holdout, geo, and lift testing rather than relying on platform-reported attribution
Build a repeatable launch playbook for new cases, including audience targeting, messaging, pacing, and milestone-driven campaigns
Run paid acquisition across social, search, and emerging channels with disciplined budget management and blended CAC targets
Own email, SMS, and community programs that convert first-time backers into repeat supporters
Build AI-powered workflows for creative production, segmentation, personalization, and research, and document them so the team can use them
Grow organic reach through SEO, AI search visibility, partnerships, creators, and earned-media tie-ins
Partner with attorneys to make sure every public claim about a case is accurate and appropriately framed
Report growth metrics, experiment results, and recommendations to leadership and the board

We prioritize demonstrated outcomes. Strong candidates will be able to show:
Experiments they designed and ran, with the baseline, the change, the result, and what they did next, including at least one that failed
AI workflows they personally built, what they replaced, and the measurable effect
How they determined whether a channel was actually driving growth or just getting credit for it
Measurable improvements in conversion, retention, or repeat purchase or donation that they owned directly
Campaigns that made a complex or unfamiliar product easy to understand and act on
In addition:
4–7 years of experience in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, with hands-on ownership of results
Strong analytical skills, including SQL, analytics platforms, and experiment design
Experience running paid acquisition and lifecycle programs at meaningful scale
Working knowledge of modern measurement, including incrementality testing and blended CAC

Ability to work independently on a remote team without dedicated analysts or designers
Experience in a fast-moving, founder-led organization

Inspire.World | Remote, U.S. | Executive Leadership Team | Employee-owned

The Opportunity - CMO with Equity Buy-in

What if everyday commerce could become an always-on engine for fundraising?

That's what we're building at Inspire.World.

This isn't a traditional CMO role.

And we're looking for someone who wants to be more than an executive.

Define our positioning, segmentation and go-to-market strategy across multiple verticals.

Build the demand engine across digital, content, partnerships, social and other channels.
Establish the metrics, processes and discipline required to create predictable pipeline and revenue growth.
Partner with executive leadership and Business Development on strategic, partner-led distribution.

2. Performance Marketing & AI

Own CAC, conversion economics, pipeline contribution and marketing ROI.
Build a data-driven, experimentation-focused marketing organization.
Make AI a fundamental part of how we create content, analyze markets, execute campaigns and reach consumers.
Establish AEO/answer-engine optimization and AI-driven discoverability as emerging growth channels.
Help ensure that when consumers turn to AI to solve a fundraising or community-commerce need, Inspire.World is part of the answer.

3. Client Campaign Services

Our marketing organization doesn't just market Inspire.World—it also markets on behalf of our customers.

You'll build and lead the team responsible for client campaigns across:

Content and creative
Social media
Email and SMS
Merchant offers and promotions
Campaign execution and optimization
Performance reporting

You'll develop the systems, technology, automation and AI capabilities required to scale this service from dozens to thousands of campaigns without creating linear headcount growth.

4. Brand & Market Leadership

Own the Inspire.World brand, messaging and market narrative.
Develop differentiated positioning for institutions, supporters, merchants and partners.
Build the proof points, case studies and trust signals required to accelerate institutional adoption.
Lead our digital presence and conversion strategy.
Build and manage the agencies, technology partners and resources required to accelerate growth.
The Executive We're Looking For

You're likely a strong fit if you:

Have 10–15+ years of digital-first marketing leadership, including significant VP/CMO-level experience.
Have scaled marketing within a B2B SaaS, marketplace, B2B2C or DTC platform environment.
Have experience building GTM strategies across multiple verticals or customer segments.
Personally understand CAC/LTV, demand generation, pipeline economics and performance marketing.
Have built and led high-performing marketing teams.
Understand how AI is changing marketing—not just as a content tool, but as an operating model.
Have experience with AEO, answer-engine optimization or emerging AI-driven discovery.
Have managed high-volume email/SMS/lifecycle marketing programs.
Have experience with partner- and channel-led growth, particularly where relationships and networks drive distribution.
Can move comfortably between strategic positioning, creative thinking, data and unit economics.
Are comfortable making decisions, testing quickly and eliminating programs that aren't working.

Experience in fundraising, nonprofit organizations, community platforms or DTC eCommerce is a plus.

How We'll Measure Success

You'll be expected to build a measurable marketing organization with clear accountability for:

Growth
Qualified pipeline
Marketing-sourced and influenced revenue
MQL → SQL → Win conversion
Vertical expansion and launch performance
Efficiency
CAC and CAC payback
Channel performance
Marketing ROI
Experimentation velocity

Client campaign revenue and margins
Cost-to-serve
Automation and scalability
Brand & Market

AEO/AI discoverability

Why This Role Is Different

We're not looking for someone to inherit a large marketing organization and maintain the status quo.

We're looking for a builder.

Someone who can help define the market, create the strategy, build the team, establish the operating model and execute.

Someone who can sit in an executive meeting discussing market segmentation in the morning and review CAC, pipeline and campaign economics in the afternoon.

Competitive executive base compensation
Performance-based compensation tied to agreed business objectives
Meaningful equity participation
Full executive benefits

Build a leadership team of operators who are also owners.

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

jobs.title: Associate SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Job

Our client is an established, high-growth, mid-size technology provider delivering B2B SaaS solutions to enterprise clients globally. We are seeking an analytical, tech-savvy Associate SEO Specialist
to join our growing digital marketing and growth team. This entry-level role is designed for a data-driven individual who wants to master the intersection of search engine algorithms, data analytics, and content strategy. Working directly alongside senior growth marketers and web developers, you will support the day-to-day execution of our organic search strategy, helping to optimize our web footprint, track keyword performance, and drive high-intent traffic to our platform.
Why Join Us

Structured Mentorship Track:
Jumpstart your career in growth marketing with direct, daily mentorship from seasoned SEO and digital strategy leaders who are invested in your technical upskilling.
The Perfect Scale:
Enjoy the stability and resources of an established mid-size tech firm, combined with the agility, speed, and visibility of a tight-knit marketing team where your work won't get lost in the crowd.
Hands-on Tooling Mastery:
Transition from theoretical knowledge to practical expertise by working daily with enterprise-grade SEO, data analytics, and digital growth platforms.

Responsibilities

Keyword Research & Trend Tracking:
Conduct foundational keyword research to identify emerging search trends, search volume changes, and content gaps that our marketing team can leverage.
On-Page Optimization Support:
Assist in updating and optimizing website metadata, heading tags, image alt text, and internal linking structures across our digital properties to improve search visibility.
Technical Site Auditing:
Run routine website crawls using industry tools to identify basic technical issues such as broken links, duplicate content, 404 errors, and slow-loading pages.
Performance Reporting:
Help maintain growth dashboards by pulling and aggregating weekly organic traffic data, keyword rankings, and impressions from Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Competitor Monitoring:
Keep a pulse on the competitive landscape, tracking competitor keyword movements and backlink profiles to identify new outreach and content opportunities.

Qualifications

Education & Domain Literacy:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related quantitative field.
Professional/Academic Experience:
0 to 2 years of experience (inclusive of digital marketing internships, university club leadership, personal blogging projects, or managed e-commerce side-hustles).
Familiarity with SEO Concepts:
A strong foundational understanding of how search engines crawl, index, and rank web pages. Familiarity with basic SEO tools (like Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Google Search Console) is highly preferred.
Basic Web & Coding Literacy:
Fundamental comfort with HTML and CSS. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should know how to read source code to locate title tags, meta descriptions, and schema markup.
Data & Excel Comfort:
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets (vlookups, data sorting, pivot tables) for organizing and analyzing large sets of keyword data.
Curiosity & Agile Mindset:
An insatiable desire to learn, experiment, and stay ahead of rapidly changing search engine algorithms and tech industry trends.

Job Details

Employment Type:
Full-Time, Permanent
Salary Range:
$60,000 – $75,000 base structure + Performance Bonus & Comprehensive Health Benefits.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
GLG is the world's leading platform for trusted human expertise. We deliver access to the freshest perspectives of the world's experts at the forefront of their industries, so clients can gain a strategic edge. Our global teams leverage leading technology and decades of proprietary data to help our clients answer business-critical and complex questions within the industry's most trusted research environment.

At the very moment when buyers are questioning which sources they can rely on, GLG sits at the intersection of trusted human expertise and intelligent technology makes it accessible. For GLG, that creates an extraordinary opportunity. The Content Marketing Strategist is a critical role within GLG's Global Marketing organization, responsible for developing and executing the content strategy that drives demand, builds authority, and advances GLG's brand across all segments and geographies. Reporting to the VP, Global Marketing, this role owns the content architecture that connects GLG's expertise to the needs of its clients throughout the entire buyer journey.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who thrives in collaboration. This role will tell our story with depth and dimension amid the AI-driven evolution of how business decisions get made and how content gets discovered, consumed, and trusted. They will work closely across teams to create a unifying strategy and innovative approach to delivering the most valuable content to our audiences in this moment of transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Architecture

Develop and own GLG marketing’s global content strategy, mapping content to buyer stages across all client segments, personas, and geographies
Establish a content framework anchored in GLG's core differentiators and position us at the forefront of how human expertise and technology come together, ensuring these through-lines are consistent and compelling across every content type and channel
Build and maintain a content calendar that integrates campaign, product launch, and commercial needs
Collaborate with the Communications team to ensure narratives are aligned with marketing priorities and amplified effectively across owned channels

Planning & Execution

Develop an integrated approach to content planning, serving as the connective tissue between Marketing, Communications, Product Marketing, and Commercial teams on content needs, priorities, and gaps; including localization in global markets
Create a disciplined approach to content sourcing, determining what should be created by GLG writers, when to leverage our robust expert content library, and when to commission directly from GLG experts
Partner with the Digital team to shape content for SEO and AI-mediated discovery, ensuring GLG’s original expertise is structured and positioned for visibility across search engines and AI-powered experiences
Translate the content strategy into a clear execution plan with owners, timelines, and defined outputs for each piece of content
Write and edit content, maintaining and applying clear standards for voice, format, and depth across content types, channels, and funnel stages
Collaborate with and brief our designers and writers, ensuring their capacity (and yours) is focused on the highest-impact content needs

Measurement and optimization

Measure content performance and apply those insights to continuously improve the strategy; establish KPIs and report on content's contribution to pipeline and engagement metrics
Ensure content is optimized for distribution across channels including website, email, LinkedIn, paid media, and sales enablement
Provide feedback loop to the Expert team to optimize content sourcing and identify new opportunities for expert content

Qualifications & Experience

4-6 years of content strategy experience in a B2B environment, with a demonstrated track record of growing into strategic ownership across both planning and execution
Exceptional writing and editing skills; able to produce and improve content and to set the editorial standard for a team and guide format selection
Strong understanding of full-funnel content architecture and how content supports demand generation, nurture, and conversion
Collaborative by nature, with the interpersonal skills to influence without authority across a matrixed global organization
Analytical mindset; comfortable using performance data to inform and adjust strategy
Fluid understanding of GEO, AEO, and the evolving content discovery landscape driven by AI-powered search
Experience in B2B information services, financial/professional services is preferred
Experience developing content in categories undergoing significant AI-driven disruption is a strong plus
Demonstrated comfort learning and adopting new AI tools and workflows to scale production and output
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field; advanced degree a plus

What We Offer

Benefits:
All U.S. GLGers also have access to benefits such as :

Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage effective on your first day of employment
Flexible paid time off. No pre-determined limits on vacation time, plus 10 company holidays
401(k) and Roth 401(k) plans with an employer match (subject to annual limits & vesting)

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Director, Performance Marketing -  Unannounced ARPG Mobile Game
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director, Performance Marketing to join our Performance Marketing team to support a new, unannounced ARPG mobile game based on a major IP. This role is available on a hybrid basis in Los Angeles, CA, or remotely within the United States.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and aim to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating within the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

The Performance Marketing team is focused on driving player growth and efficiency across a diverse set of digital marketing channels. With teams across the US and Europe, the team operates in a fast-evolving mobile advertising ecosystem.

In this role, you will play a critical part in launching and scaling Scopely’s next major title, shaping user acquisition strategy from pre-launch testing through global scale.

The Director, Performance Marketing will lead global performance marketing strategy and execution for a new, unannounced ARPG mobile title based on a major IP. This role is responsible for driving player growth, building scalable acquisition strategies, optimizing multi-million-dollar budgets, and developing a high-performing performance marketing team across global markets.

What You Will Do

You will lead performance marketing efforts for a new, unannounced ARPG title based on a major IP, driving global user growth and building scalable acquisition strategies from pre-launch through live operations.
Own and lead global go-to-market performance marketing strategy and execution for the new title, from pre-launch testing through global scale.
Define and execute user acquisition strategies, methodologies, and processes to achieve growth and efficiency targets.
Partner with Product, Strategic Marketing, Growth, Finance, Analytics, Creative, and Data Engineering teams to align UA strategy with game positioning, audience targeting, lifecycle marketing, and business goals.
Build and scale acquisition programs across key channels, including Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs, ad networks, and emerging platforms.
Establish and optimize full-funnel measurement frameworks, including KPI definition, attribution strategy, incrementality testing, and LTV modeling.
Drive deep analytical insights into campaign performance, working with Analytics and Data Science to improve forecasting and decision-making.
Build and oversee Scopely’s UA pod in Shanghai, China.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of performance marketers, fostering accountability, innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate cross-functionally to enhance creative strategy, marketing technology, automation, and fraud prevention systems.
Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar marketing budgets with a focus on ROI and long-term player value.

What We’re Looking For

Fluent in English and Mandarin
Preferred experience working with Chinese gaming studios
Deep understanding of the Performance Marketing best practices on the Chinese gaming market
8+ years of performance marketing / user acquisition experience, ideally within mobile gaming or consumer apps
4+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams
Proven success managing and scaling multi-million dollar acquisition budgets across multiple channels
Strong experience with major platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic networks, etc.) Demonstrated expertise in go-to-market strategy, launch planning, and scaling new products
Deep analytical mindset with experience in attribution, incrementality testing, LTV modeling, and performance forecasting
Track record of driving significant growth through improvements in automation, marketing tech, or data infrastructure
Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Bonus: Experience in Midcore, RPG, Strategy 4x mobile games

Bonus Points

Experience working with Chinese gaming studios.
Deep understanding of performance marketing best practices in the Chinese gaming market.
Experience in midcore, RPG, or 4X strategy mobile games.

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone—and we believe the people behind our games should reflect that. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to thrive.

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range

$160,000—$230,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.
For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.
As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!
Job Overview 

We are seeking a Paid Digital Marketing Manager
to own and scale our paid digital strategy for Mitratech’s Workforce Compliance and HR Solutions portfolio, including Background Screening, I-9 Compliance, HR Compliance & Expertise, and Leave Management solutions.  
This role is responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and reporting on paid digital programs that drive qualified demand across the full sales and marketing funnel. You’ll work closely with product marketing, demand generation, sales, and revenue operations to ensure paid media programs are data-driven, AI-enabled, and tightly aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.  
This is a hands-on, individual contributor role ideal for a performance marketer who is comfortable operating both strategically and tactically in a B2B SaaS environment.  
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
:
Paid Media Strategy & Execution

Ensure alignment of all paid digital initiatives with business priorities, solution-level goals, and defined KPIs, including pipeline contribution, revenue impact, and efficiency metrics.  

Develop, execute, and optimize paid digital programs across channels, including paid search (Google Ads and Bing Ads), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), display, retargeting, and B2B review and marketplace platforms (e.g., Capterra, Software Advice, SHRM MediaBrains) to support pipeline and revenue targets.  

Own channel-level budgeting, forecasting, pacing, and performance optimization across multiple HR solutions and buyer personas.  

Translate product positioning and campaign strategy into high-performing paid media programs aligned to each stage of the buyer journey.  

Partner with Product Marketing to ensure messaging, keywords, and creative reflect compliance-driven value propositions and customer pain points.  

AI-Forward & Data-Driven Marketing

Leverage AI-powered bidding, audience targeting, creative testing, and optimization tools within paid platforms to improve efficiency and performance.  

Use AI and automation to scale keyword expansion, ad variation testing, audience segmentation, and performance insights.  

Apply predictive and behavioral data to inform spend allocation, audience prioritization, and conversion optimization.  

Continuously evaluate and pilot emerging AI-driven advertising tools and capabilities to maintain a competitive edge.  

Optimization, Testing & Analytics

Prepare and present performance insights, recommendations, and strategic readouts to senior marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, including C-suite and executive audiences, translating complex data into clear business impact.  

Design and manage A/B and multivariate tests across ads, landing pages, audiences, and offers to improve conversion rates and CPL.  

Monitor performance against KPIs, including CPL, CAC, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, and ROI.  

Analyze campaign, channel, and cohort-level data to deliver actionable insights and recommendations to marketing and sales leadership.  

Partner with web and CRO teams to optimize landing page experience, conversion paths, and form strategy.  

Martech, Attribution & Collaboration

Manage and optimize integrations between paid platforms, marketing automation (HubSpot), CRM (Salesforce), and analytics tools.  

Ensure clean tracking, attribution, and reporting across the funnel in collaboration with Revenue Operations.  

Work cross-functionally with to align paid programs to active campaigns, events, and sales priorities.  

Manage external vendors or agencies as needed to support execution and scale.  

Perform other related duties as assigned.  

Requirements & Skills:

Required Qualifications

4–6 years of experience in paid digital marketing, performance marketing, or demand generation within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.  

Hands-on experience managing paid search (Google/Bing), paid social (LinkedIn), display, and retargeting campaigns.  

Strong understanding of full-funnel B2B demand models, lead lifecycle management, and revenue attribution.  

Experience using marketing automation platforms (HubSpot) and CRM systems (Salesforce).  

Proven ability to analyze data, identify insights, and translate performance data into optimization actions.  

Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product marketing, sales, and operations teams.  

AI & Technical Skills (Must-Have or Strong Plus)

Experience leveraging AI-driven features within ad platforms (e.g., automated bidding, audience expansion, responsive ads).  

Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for keyword research, creative development, performance analysis, and experimentation.  

Experience with 6sense is a significant plus, including use of intent data, account-based targeting, audience activation, and orchestration of paid media across channels. Candidates with hands-on 6sense experience will be prioritized and moved to the top of the candidate pool.  

Strong analytical mindset with experience using analytics tools.  

Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution models, and marketing data pipelines.  

Preferred Experience

Experience marketing HR, payroll, compliance, or SaaS solutions.  

Familiarity with regulated or compliance-driven industries.  

Experience supporting multi-solution or portfolio-based marketing strategies.  
Exposure to conversion rate optimization, landing page optimization, and personalization strategies.

Our fast-growing tax firm is looking for a highly skilled Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to own the day-to-day execution and coordination of our digital marketing engine. You will turn high-level strategy and content into polished campaigns across email, social media, YouTube, paid media, website funnels, and other digital channels—while ensuring projects, vendors, deadlines, and performance tracking are managed with precision. This role is ideal for a strong marketer who combines exceptional copywriting, sharp marketing judgment, strong analytics, and disciplined marketing operations.

Why Join Us?

High-Impact Role:
Own day-to-day marketing execution and directly influence growth at an Inc. 5000 fastest-growing tax firm
Growth Opportunity:
Grow into the firm's "Director of Marketing", and eventually, Chief Marketing Officer
Marketing Exposure:
Work across content, email, paid media, funnels, SEO, social media, analytics, automation, and vendor management.
100% Remote:
Work from home will collaborating closely with the CEO, internal team members, and outside marketing partners

Responsibilities
Copywriting & Content Creation
– Write compelling copy across social media, paid advertisements, landing pages, websites, PR responses, email, SMS, and other marketing channels; help research, develop, and refine short-form and long-form video scripts while maintaining a consistent and engaging brand voice.
Content Marketing & Repurposing
– Turn long-form videos, technical source material, and other core content into short-form videos, social posts, emails, articles, and other marketing assets; develop YouTube titles, hooks, thumbnail concepts, descriptions, and creative angles designed to increase engagement.
Marketing Operations & Campaign Execution
– Own the marketing calendar and coordinate campaigns from idea through execution, ensuring content, emails, SMS, social posts, advertisements, and other initiatives are properly built, reviewed, scheduled, tested, and launched on time.
Social Media, Email & CRM Management
– Manage publishing across the firm's primary social platforms and execute email/SMS campaigns, lead nurture sequences, automations, forms, workflows, landing pages, and funnels using GoHighLevel and other marketing platforms.
Website & Funnel Optimization
– Manage routine WordPress and landing-page updates, improve website and funnel copy, identify conversion opportunities, and coordinate more advanced website or development needs with external resources when necessary.
Analytics & Growth Optimization
– Track and analyze performance across YouTube, social media, email, website traffic, funnels, SEO, and paid advertising; develop recurring performance reports and use data to recommend and test improvements to copy, creative, offers, campaigns, and conversion rates.
Paid Media, SEO & Vendor Management
– Monitor paid advertising and SEO performance, recommend new creative concepts and growth opportunities, and manage agencies, video editors, designers, PR partners, web developers, and other vendors to ensure quality work, timely delivery, and measurable results.
Quality Control, Systems & Ownership
– Review marketing deliverables for accuracy, quality, brand consistency, functioning links, and proper execution; build and improve SOPs, checklists, and workflows; proactively identify problems and opportunities and take ownership of ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

The Ideal Candidate
At least 3 years of full-time experience in digital marketing, content marketing, paid media, marketing operations, or related field
Exceptional Copywriting Skills: Comfortable writing video scripts, website copy, email, SMS, social media, advertisements, landing pages, and other marketing materials.
Marketing Technology Experience: Experience with platforms such as WordPress, HighLevel, CRM/email marketing automation platforms, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Manager, Google Ads Manager, YouTube Studio, and related digital tools
Fast Learner: Able to quickly learn our business, audience, services, technical subject matter, systems, and marketing processes.
High Attention to Detail – Able to catch copy errors, incorrect links, missed deadlines, campaign setup mistakes, and quality issues before they reach the public.
