jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications, Veterinary Medicine
jobs.description:
The Director of Marketing and Communications for the Virginia-Maryland College of Veterinary Medicine (VMCVM) is responsible for developing, planning, executing, and measuring a comprehensive, strategic marketing and communications program for VMCVM and aligning those activities with university-level communications, marketing, branding priorities, and initiatives. The marketing and communications program led by the Director will embody and reflect the VMCVM’s core values, principles, strategic goals and priorities, and VMCVM’s unique attributes and offerings that contribute to the broader understanding of Virginia Tech.

In support of a successful marketing and communications program for VMCVM and the university, the Director will collaborate with and/or be a part of several teams, including the VMCVM’s Dean and senior leadership group; the VMCVM’s advancement team (including marketing and communications, alumni engagement and referring practitioner relations, and development); marketing and communications directors in other colleges and units across the university; and colleagues in the Advancement and Marketing and Communications divisions, among others. The Director collaborates with university leadership, faculty, staff, students, alumni, friends, grateful clients, and external partners to support marketing and communications initiatives.

Currently, the Director directly leads and supervises a team of four marketing and communications professionals, providing performance planning and evaluation, direction, support, and professional development opportunities. In addition, the Director works with VMCVM department heads and teaching hospital administration to align marketing and communications work to both VMCVM and university priorities.

Elements of a comprehensive and strategic marketing and communications program for VMCVM will include a wide range of tactics and strategies, including communications plans, news and feature stories, speeches for VMCVM leadership, message alignment, marketing campaigns, media relations and pitches, publications, photography and videography, social media, advertising, and similar items. Specific platforms include websites, news and information websites, email newsletters, and social media channels that support the VMCVM.

The Director will have a strong record of progressive experience in today's marketing and communications fields, including the development and implementation of a strategic, comprehensive marketing and communications program; evidence of strong communications, interpersonal, presentation, and marketing skills; and proficiency in using word processing, image processing, content management system, and social media tools. The ideal candidate will also have experience leading a team of marketing and communications professionals; a strong understanding of effective graphic design and branding principles and the use of the Internet as a medium of communication; and the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

This position supports VMCVM and university initiatives in Blacksburg, Roanoke, and the greater Washington, D.C. metro area, including the three teaching hospitals in Blacksburg, Roanoke, and Leesburg, Virginia. The Director is designated as emergency personnel.

The position is based at the Virginia Tech campus in Blacksburg, Virginia. The position reports to both the Senior Director of Marketing and Communications, Virginia Tech, and the Assistant Dean of Advancement of VMCVM.

Key Responsibilities:
● Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive, strategic marketing and communications plan that supports VMCVM and university’s mission and integrates university and VMCVM priorities.
● Oversee and manage the creation of high-quality, engaging content, and create such content, for VMCVM and university digital and print platforms that effectively communicates VMCVM’s and the university’s vision, mission, and achievements to key audiences.
● Ensure that VMCVM content is consistent with the university brand and standards such as editorial, messaging, and graphic design guidelines.
● Exercise oversight of all marketing and communications activities throughout VMCVM.
● Leverage metrics to gauge the effectiveness of marketing and communications strategies and make data-informed decisions to improve marketing and communications efforts.
● Collaborate with various teams, including the VMCVM advancement team, the VMCVM leadership team, the Council of the senior-most marketing and communications professionals from colleges and units across campus, university communicators, Marketing and Communications, and others.
● Oversee the quality of VMCVM content as an editor for content across various platforms, including websites, social media, newsletters, reports, promotional materials, and more.
● In collaboration with the university’s media relations team, develop and manage a comprehensive media relations program targeting strategic regional, trade, and national media outlets.
Required Qualifications

Master's degree in communications, journalism, or related field; or bachelor's with experience equating to an advanced degree

Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive, strategic marketing and communications program

Ability to define goals and objectives, identify target audiences, and measure progress toward communications and marketing goals

Demonstrated strong communications, leadership, and interpersonal skills

Familiarity with a range of communications principles including messaging, graphic design, visual communications, branding, marketing, advertising, electronic communications, and social media

Ability to be self-motivated and capable of working in a complex matrix management environment
Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with veterinary medicine teaching and research techniques and ability to communicate highly technical content to a general audience

Demonstrated experience supervising communications professionals

Experience in executing marketing initiatives and the analysis and application of market research, in a veterinary medicine, medical school, hospital, or higher education setting

Experience working with business/industry, alumni engagement, or development initiatives

Demonstrated budgetary supervision experience

Experience in a higher education, independent school, scientific organization, or nonprofit environment

Strong skills using technology in the workplace, familiarity with content management systems and email platforms; social media competencies

Significant prior communications experience writing and producing publications, developing and placing stories with external media, and collaborating with medical professionals
Overtime Status

Exempt: Not eligible for overtime

Regular

$95,000–$110,000

40+

November 15th, 2026

Must have the ability and willingness to travel utilizing standard, commercial, and/or personal modes of transportation.

Ability to work nights and weekends, and participation in college or university programs when possible.
The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check.

About Virginia Tech

Dedicated to its motto, Ut Prosim (That I May Serve), Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a hands-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be leaders and problem-solvers. A comprehensive land-grant institution that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the world, Virginia Tech is an inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and professional students in eight undergraduate colleges, a school of medicine, a veterinary medicine college, Graduate School, and Honors College. The university has a significant presence across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C. area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous Extension offices and research institutes. A leading global research institution, Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research annually.

Nordson Industrial Coating Solutions
, a global leader in Industrial Coating Solutions, is seeking an experienced and highly motivated individual to join our team. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we are looking for candidates who share that same commitment.

Summary Of The Role

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your ideas and contributions will be valued and respected.

Job Summary

The Marketing Intern will support the Industrial Coating Systems (ICS) Marketing team through a combination of strategic marketing, product portfolio management, marketing communications, digital marketing, content development, and business analytics activities. The primary focus of the internship will be supporting strategic marketing initiatives, including market research, customer insights, product portfolio analysis, competitive intelligence, and new product development activities. Secondary responsibilities will include supporting marketing communications, content creation, digital marketing campaigns, lead generation initiatives, and marketing analytics.

This position provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience across multiple marketing disciplines while working closely with Product Management, Marketing Communications, Sales, Engineering, and Business Leadership teams.

Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities

Strategic Marketing & Product Portfolio Support

Assist with market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight projects.
Support Voice of the Customer (VOC) activities, including surveys, interviews, and analysis of customer feedback.
Assist with product portfolio analysis, market segmentation, and market opportunity assessments.
Support Product Managers with new product development (NPD) and stage-gate activities.
Help develop presentations, business cases, and strategic marketing recommendations.
Gather and organize market intelligence, competitor information, and industry trends.
Assist with product launch preparation and go-to-market planning activities.
Support pricing, product lifecycle, and portfolio management projects as needed.

Marketing Communications & Content Marketing

Assist in developing content for marketing campaigns, product launches, trade shows, and promotional initiatives.
Support creation of marketing collateral, presentations, brochures, customer communications, and sales enablement materials.
Help create and manage content for websites, email campaigns, social media platforms, and other digital channels.
Assist with content research, writing, editing, and content organization to align with customer needs and business objectives.
Support trade show, event, customer seminar, and exhibition planning activities.
Assist with video, photography, and multimedia content projects when needed.
Help monitor content engagement and campaign effectiveness using analytics and reporting tools.
Assist with development of sales tools and launch materials that support product introductions and growth initiatives.

Digital Marketing & Analytics Support

Assist with execution of digital marketing campaigns across email, web, and social media channels.
Support website updates and search engine optimization (SEO) initiatives.
Assist with CRM data management, lead tracking, and marketing automation activities.
Collect, organize, and analyze marketing and business data.
Assist in developing marketing reports, dashboards, charts, and presentations.
Help identify trends and insights that support business and marketing decision-making.
Support lead generation and campaign tracking activities to improve marketing effectiveness and customer engagement.

Education And Experience Requirements

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, International Business, Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering, or Data Analytics from an accredited university.
Must be enrolled in an accredited university program and returning to school following the internship.
Minimum GPA requirement may be established based on business needs.

Preferred Skills And Abilities

Strong interest in strategic marketing, product management, and business analytics.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to analyze information and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Interest in content creation, storytelling, and marketing communications.
Familiarity with social media platforms, digital marketing concepts, SEO, or Google Analytics is a plus.
Exposure to CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, or data visualization tools is beneficial.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Self-starter with a willingness to learn and contribute within a collaborative team environment.

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Office environment:
The intern will work alongside marketing professionals and business leaders while supporting a variety of strategic marketing, communications, and digital marketing initiatives. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Travel Required

None

Minimal

Estimated

Interested?

If you are interested in being a part of a team and creating an inclusive and diverse workplace, please apply online with your CV.

About Nordson Industrial Coating Solutions

Manufacturers rely on Nordson Industrial Coating Solutions equipment for the precise application and curing of powder coatings, liquid paint, ambient temperature adhesives and sealants, and food and beverage container production. By joining our team today, you will help us bring innovative ideas to life. Nordson Industrial Coating Solutions is a global team that works to create industrial coating solutions that help our customers improve their manufacturing process, produce better products and become even more competitive. We offer a supportive culture in a growing and dynamic work environment. Whether you're just beginning your career or you're a seasoned professional, there's a place for you to belong at Nordson Industrial Coating Solutions. We offer hourly and salary positions in production, maintenance, customer service, quality, engineering, and more. We actively invest in our teams to help you build your skillsets and advance your career.

jobs.title: Senior Content Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens has grown through referrals and relationships. Now we're building a content engine that earns attention beyond them. As our Senior Content Specialist, you'll be an early member of a small, growing marketing team, reporting to the Director of Marketing and working side by side with product marketing, events, marketing operations, and design.

You'll drive how Zipliens shows up in search engines (SERPs and AI platforms) and in the resources law firms rely on: our SEO strategy and baseline, website content, the LinkedIn content calendar, blog posts, customer newsletters, and case studies. Lien resolution is technical (Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation), and your job is to turn that complexity into content that paralegals, case managers, and attorneys actually find, use, and trust.

You'll thrive here if you love both the craft of a sharp draft and the discipline of keyword research and performance data, enjoy pulling insight out of subject-matter experts, solving industry pain points through creative mediums, and want to build a content program from the ground up. The role is primarily hands-on writing and execution, with growing ownership of strategy and planning as the program grows.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Build the SEO and content strategy

Establish an organic search baseline (traffic, impressions, rankings, branded vs. non-branded performance, top landing pages, backlinks, and technical health) before optimizing.
Partner with internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop and execute the keyword and topic strategy across lien resolution, Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation, settlement administration, and personal injury firm operations, balancing high-intent commercial terms with educational and long-tail searches.
Build and maintain the editorial/blog calendar, aligned to our ideal customer profile, product launches, and events.
Partner with marketing operations to connect organic visibility to qualified traffic, leads, and pipeline rather than traffic volume alone.

Create content that earns trust

Write and edit blog posts, guides, checklists, templates, FAQs, and reports that help personal injury law firm teams solve real lien resolution problems.
Partner with lien resolution SMEs, Customer Success, and company leadership to turn operational and regulatory knowledge into accurate, practical content.
Use Voice of the Customer (VOC) insights to develop customer case studies and spotlights that put proof behind our positioning, working with Product Marketing and Customer Success.
Support executive and employee thought leadership, including LinkedIn posts, bylines, and speaking abstracts.
Turn each strong source asset into multiple formats across channels.

Own website content and marketing collateral

Manage Zipliens’ public-facing resource center, partnering with subject matter experts to develop and publish content such as eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, infographics, etc.
Write and optimize website content, including service pages, landing pages, and metadata, in partnership with Product Marketing and Design.
Run on-page SEO/AEO and regular content refreshes, updating or consolidating underperforming pages.
Partner with marketing operations on calls to action, forms, and conversion paths so content connects to Sales.

Run channels and customer communications

Manage the LinkedIn content calendar, balancing core themes/pillars: thought leadership, brand awareness, campaign messaging, customer outcomes, employee advocacy, and event promotion.
Write and edit customer newsletter, nurture, and release-announcement copy, partnering with Customer Success, Product Marketing, and the team member building campaigns in HubSpot.
Create event content with the Events Manager, including pre-event promotion, session and speaker content, and post-event recaps.
Report on content performance regularly and recommend what to scale, update, or stop.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years in content marketing, SEO, or B2B content strategy, with a portfolio of published work.
Experience supporting organic traffic growth through SEO-driven content, and a solid understanding of how SEO strategy translates into rankings and conversions.
Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate technical or regulated topics into clear, accurate content.
Experience interviewing subject-matter experts and turning their input into finished content.
Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and repurposing while maintaining accuracy and brand voice.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and build process in a small team.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred

Hands-on experience with SEO and analytics tools (e.g., Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, or Ahrefs) and a CMS.
Experience in legal, legal tech, insurance, healthcare, or other complex or regulated B2B topics; familiarity with personal injury or lien resolution is a plus.
Experience with HubSpot (CMS, email, and reporting).
Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for team meetings, offsites, and select events.

Benefits

Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants
Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)
Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Coverage
Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options
401(k) Plan with Company Match
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time & 10 paid Holidays)
Parental Leave

Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $75,500 - $95,500
annually, with opportunity for a quarterly discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager - Sales & Marketing and Revenue
jobs.description:
Description

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you will be the primary finance business partner for the Company's US Sales & Marketing organization, working closely with a wide range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access.

You will also oversee the Company's Gross-to-Net (GTN) revenue estimates and financial reporting. Most of the GTN modeling and data processing is outsourced to a specialized third-party provider (Integrichain / ICH); in this role, you will control, challenge, and validate the work performed by ICH rather than build or maintain the underlying models yourself.

Location
: Warren, New Jersey - minimum 3 days on site

Salary Range
: $140-160k

Key Responsibilities

FP&A / Business Partnering – Sales & Marketing (Priority #1):

Act as the lead finance business partner for US Sales & Marketing leadership, managing a wide range of stakeholders and moving parts across the organization.
Lead the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes for Sales & Marketing expenses.
Analyze trends and variances against budget/forecast, provide decision-support indicators, and identify risks and opportunities across all partnered functions.
Support senior leaders (VP Sales, VP Marketing, and Market Access) on investments, projects, contracts, and resource allocation decisions.
Challenge business owners on their forecasts and planning assumptions; ensure spend discipline and visibility across a broad and evolving set of partners.
Actively participate in the monthly and quarterly financial closing process for the Sales & Marketing scope.

Revenue & Gross-to-Net (GTN) – Oversight & Control

Oversee and control the Gross-to-Net (GTN) estimates and deliverables prepared by the Company's outsourced GTN provider (Integrichain / ICH), rather than building or maintaining the GTN models directly.
Review and challenge ICH's monthly and quarterly GTN accruals (rebates, chargebacks, discounts, returns, Medicaid/Medicare/340B, distribution and prompt-pay fees) for completeness and accuracy.
Act as the main internal point of contact with ICH, ensuring deliverables are timely, well-documented, and aligned with contract terms and business assumptions.
Monitor GTN ratios and deductions as a percentage of gross sales, flagging unexpected trends or variances to Accounting and senior Finance leadership.
Ensure GTN estimates and revenue recognition are compliant with US GAAP (ASC 606) and support internal/external audit requests.

Contribution To Financial Reporting

Contribute to the preparation of US GAAP financial disclosures (10-Q, 10-K) related to revenue, GTN reserves, and Sales & Marketing expenses during quarterly and annual closings.
Prepare management reporting packages and Board/Executive Committee materials on commercial and revenue performance.

Continuous Improvement

Contribute to the enhancement and automation of Sales & Marketing and GTN reporting and planning tools.
Integrate non-financial KPIs into financial models and management reporting.
Improve existing processes to strengthen the reliability, timeliness, and relevance of financial information.

Ensure internal control procedures (SOX) are properly implemented and maintained within the scope

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration required; MBA, CPA, or CMA is a plus
Minimum 5–7 years of progressive FP&A or commercial finance experience, ideally within the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, including exposure to Sales & Marketing business partnering.

Behavioral skills :

A few years of experience as a manager (or senior analyst) within a Gross-to-Net (GTN) team is sufficient; deep GTN model-building expertise is not required, as most GTN activities are outsourced to a specialized third-party provider (Integrichain / ICH).
Experience managing or overseeing outsourced service providers / vendors is a plus.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with ERP/EPM systems (e.g., Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Hyperion) required.
Working knowledge of US GAAP revenue recognition (ASC 606) and the main components of Gross-to-Net (rebates, chargebacks, discounts, Medicaid/Medicare/340B), sufficient to control and challenge third-party deliverables.
This is a high-exposure role requiring strong business partnering capabilities, with direct interaction with a broad and evolving set of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access functions.
Rigor, autonomy, responsiveness, and the ability to operate in a demanding, fast-paced environment with many moving parts are essential.
Strong analytical skills, ability to prioritize, proactive mindset, synthesis skills, and intellectual curiosity are key to success in this role.
Curiosity: Keep on exploring uncharted territories. Always ask “why?” and more importantly “why not?”,
Courage: Take smart risks, mentor each other to always do better & be accountable for our choices, our opinions, and our actions,
Collaboration: Teamwork and spirit. Support each other and be equally involved in the achievement of our common goals,
Credibility: Be transparent, follow through and build trust. Educate ourselves about our unique technology.

Champion is an award-winning public relations and digital media agency specializing in food and beverage brands and franchise marketing. We are looking for a creative and organized Social Media Specialist with 1–2 years of experience to manage client social media accounts, develop content strategies, and support marketing campaigns. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys staying on top of trends, building client relationships, and bringing fresh ideas to a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Champion is a best-in-class, fully integrated marketing agency powered by a team of nearly 50 professionals who are experts in their respective fields and driven by a common purpose – to be an indispensable partner to our clients. We recognize that every brand is unique, requiring thoughtfully crafted programs designed to achieve both short- and long-term goals. Our clients know they will never get a “one size fits all” approach from their Champion team.

What You'll Own

Manage day-to-day social media activities across multiple client accounts, including more complex campaigns and client needs.
Lead routine client communications, including status calls, meeting agendas, project recaps, and performance updates.
Develop monthly content calendars and publishing strategies that align with each client's goals and brand.
Use audience insights and social media performance to recommend content ideas and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with PR, influencer, creative, paid media, and account teams to support integrated marketing campaigns.
Manage community engagement and social listening to monitor conversations, brand mentions, and audience sentiment.
Identify trending topics, platform updates, and real-time opportunities to increase engagement and brand visibility.
Present social media recommendations, campaign results, and new ideas to clients and internal teams.
Regularly bring forward creative ideas for leveraging current trends or developing new opportunities for client brands.
Track social media KPIs and turn performance data into actionable recommendations.
Mentor and guide interns, helping them build social media skills and prepare for future coordinator-level responsibilities.
Manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining high-quality work and consistent client communication.

What We're Looking For

1–2 years of experience in social media, digital marketing, public relations, communications, or a related field.
Experience managing social media accounts and developing content calendars.
Strong understanding of major social media platforms and their unique audiences, content formats, and best practices.
Ability to review analytics and use performance insights to recommend improvements.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence leading routine client discussions.
Good project management skills and the ability to balance multiple accounts, campaigns, and deadlines.
A creative mindset, with the ability to proactively bring new ideas and recommendations to the team.
Strong organizational skills, professionalism, and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively and take ownership of assigned client accounts and projects.
Interest in developing stronger strategic thinking and client management skills.

Nice to Have

Experience working in a public relations, digital marketing, advertising, or franchise marketing agency.
Experience managing multiple client accounts or supporting larger marketing campaigns.
Familiarity with social media scheduling, analytics, reporting, and social listening tools.
Exposure to influencer marketing, media relations, community management, or integrated campaigns.
Experience mentoring interns or supporting junior team members.
A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.

Why Champion

You'll work on brands people actually recognize and on campaigns where the results show up in a restaurant's sales the same week. Our digital practice is growing and new digital tools are being unlocked regularly. If you want to own accounts, go deep technically, and see your work move a business, this is that seat.

jobs.title: Menswear Social Media Manager & Content Creator
jobs.description:
Social Media Manager & Content Creator

Location: Valley Stream, NY

Schedule: 4 days per week in office | 1 day WFH

Salary: $75,000 per year

About Twillory

Twillory makes clothes that feel like nothing: dress shirts, suits, blazers, polos and pants built from breathable, stretchy performance fabric. We started in menswear, and this month we’re launching our first women’s line. You’ll be building content for both from day one.

We sell mostly online, have two stores in the New York area, and we’re growing fast. We want our social to look like it.

The role

We’re hiring someone who lives on social and can make content that doesn’t look like an ad. You’ll come up with the idea, shoot it, edit it yourself and post it. No waiting on an agency or an editor.

This is an on-camera role. Menswear is most of our business, so a big part of the job is being the face of it: wearing and styling our men’s shirts, suits and pants on camera every week.

You’ll own Twillory’s organic presence on Instagram and TikTok, and the content you make will also run as paid ads. If a video works organically, we’ll put money behind it. You’ll work closely with our creative and paid media team.

What you’ll do

Be on camera in our menswear.
Model and style our men’s line in your own content most weeks: try-ons, fit checks, get-ready-with-me, outfit breakdowns. You’re the guy in the videos as much as the one making them.
Make content every week.
Shoot and edit short-form video (Reels, TikToks, Stories) and photo posts that feel native to the feed: styling videos, try-ons, day-in-the-life, trends, street interviews, behind the scenes in our stores and studio.
Edit it yourself.
Take raw footage to a finished post in CapCut, Premiere or similar. Cuts, captions, sound, pacing, text on screen.
Run our accounts.
Plan and keep the content calendar, post consistently, write captions, and handle comments and DMs with personality.
Know what’s happening on social.
Spot trends, sounds and formats early and turn them into Twillory content the same week, not the next month.
Show the clothes looking good.
Different outfits, different places, real guys. Make a dress shirt look as cool on your feed as it does on a person.
Feed our ads.
Hand off your best organic content for paid, and make variations (new hooks, new openings) when something works.
Work with creators.
Help brief and direct UGC creators and influencers, including for the women’s line.
Learn from the numbers.
Track views, saves, shares, follower growth and watch time. Double down on what’s working and kill what isn’t.
Cover launches and moments.
New products, sales, store events and the women’s line launch.

Who you are

You’re comfortable modeling menswear on camera and do it regularly, in your own content or for brands. Your portfolio should show it.
You’re on TikTok and Instagram more than anyone you know, and you can explain why a video blew up.
You have a portfolio of content you shot and edited yourself: a personal account, a brand you’ve worked with, or both. We want to see it.
You edit fast and well. You don’t need someone else to finish your videos.
You’ve grown an account, or a piece of content, and can tell us how.
You’re comfortable with a phone, a ring light and a mic, and you know how to make good lighting out of a window.
You care about style and have taste. You know what looks cool and what looks like a catalog.
You’re comfortable directing other people on camera.
You move quickly, take feedback well, and can manage your own calendar without being chased.
2–3 years making social content for a brand, creator or agency, or the equivalent body of your own work.

Bonus points

Fashion, menswear or DTC ecommerce experience
You’ve made content that ran as a paid ad and know what makes an ad stop the scroll
Photography skills
Experience working with UGC creators or influencers
Comfortable with Adobe Premiere, After Effects or Lightroom on top of CapCut

How to apply:

Send your resume and links to 3–5 pieces of content you shot and edited yourself, including at least one where you’re on camera wearing menswear. Tell us in a sentence or two which one performed best and why you think it worked.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Update website content and Downtown event listings; verify dates, times, locations, and other public information.

Create and adapt basic graphics using approved templates and brand standards; organize event photographs and promotional assets.

Support consistent staff procedures for customer service, skate rentals, food handling, cleaning, point-of-sale transactions, and opening and closing duties.

One to two years of relevant experience in marketing, events, hospitality, customer service, or program coordination.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with social media publishing and website updates. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator preferred.

We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
Overview

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Demand Generation Manager to launch multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to capture demand for our Observability business.
You are responsible for mid-to-bottom funnel campaigns that drive net-new customer acquisition pipeline and revenue for SolarWinds Observability — owning campaign planning, program execution, and performance reporting for this solution. You bring strong judgment and initiative, collaborate well across functions, and have a growth and experimentation mindset.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise that balances a strong understanding of how buyers move through a journey with a strong track record of shaping narratives and translating audience understanding into high-performing demand programs the drive sales-ready leads. What matters most is your ability to connect strategy to execution and elevate how demand is built across the funnel.

Key Responsibilities

Translate GTM strategy and product priorities into demand generation strategies that generate qualified new business pipeline for SolarWinds Observability.
Own campaign strategies across mid-to-bottom funnel, from consideration to conversion.
Support the creation of sales-ready leads through a tightly orchestrated retargeting strategy with conversions across free trial activations, interactive demos, quotes and more.
Develop and manage a fleet of Al agents, skills, and autonomous workflows that support advanced targeting, multi-channel orchestration and personalization at scale to improve bottom of funnel conversion rates.
Work closely with SDRs to align on lead follow up to support healthy conversion rates from routed lead to sales opportunity.
Develop a testing roadmap to capture demand in partnership with the CRO team. Set benchmarks and clear conversion targets.
Apply a strong understanding of how CIO and senior IT buyers evaluate, purchase, and adopt observability platforms to shape messaging, content, and campaign strategy.
Partner with Product Marketing to ensure campaign materials resonate with IT decision makers and reflect current market dynamics.
Own campaign measurement and optimization, using data and insights to iterate, scale, and improve performance.
Use performance data to identify what's working, flag issues early, and recommend optimizations.

Qualifications

7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a focus on demand generation, integrated campaigns ideally within SaaS or enterprise technology.
Proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue for new business.
Experience executing campaigns across a variety of channels including paid ads, email, web, social, chatbot, and events.
Understand how to build AI skills vs AI agents and how to create and map complex workflows and think through automation to augment and develop demand gen programs. Advanced proficiency with marketing automation and CRM platforms (Marketo, Salesforce). Experience with tools such as 6sense, Goldcast, Qualified, Outreach, Zapier, Clay, or similar tools.
Are data-driven: you track what matters, use metrics to optimize, and can clearly connect your programs to pipeline outcomes.
Collaborate well across functions — product, sales, partners, regional teams — and communicate proactively to keep things moving.
Ability to measure and optimize campaign performance. You like to launch fast and iterate based on the data.
Are energized by ownership and accountability — you don't wait to be told; you identify what needs to happen and make it happen.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Americas Field Marketing, AI
jobs.description:
About Stripe

Stripe's infrastructure and suite of APIs powers hundreds of thousands of businesses—from startups to Fortune 500s—in almost every country around the world. From developers and product managers to founders and CFOs, a broad audience interacts with Stripe's products and uses them to start, run, and scale their companies. Removing the barriers to online commerce helps more new businesses get started, expedites growth for existing companies, and increases economic output and trade globally.

We operate at a significant scale, but we're still tiny relative to the opportunity ahead, so there is still much to do. Join us and help put the global economy within everyone's reach.

Role Overview

We're seeking an experienced, creative, and results-oriented marketer who knows the AI ecosystem to drive world-class field marketing for AI organizations in the Americas region. This field marketer will be responsible for executing marketing strategies that delivers growth and revenue at scale for AI businesses. The ideal candidate is data-driven, relentlessly seeks to optimize, stays at the cutting edge of modern marketing practices, and has a passion for collaborating with sales teams to drive successful customer outcomes. As a member of the Americas Marketing team, this is a great opportunity to build and have a significant impact on our rapidly growing business.

About The Team

The Americas Marketing team is a high-performing group laser-focused on fueling Stripe's expansion across the region. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact by building and optimizing programs and strategies. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Sales, Product, Partnerships, and others to drive measurable business results and growth.

You Will

Execute the regional field marketing strategy and plan to fuel pipeline growth with the AI sales teams across the Americas
Monitor key business and revenue metrics, providing cross-functional insights to drive continuous optimization and improvement
Partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns
Develop and implement an events strategy, including third-party and Stripe-hosted events (in-person, virtual, and hybrid) that will deliver results for the AI segment
Design and execute mid- and lower-funnel Account Based Marketing programs to accelerate leads, opportunities, and revenue growth
Develop a focus on acquiring contacts in AI organizations by creating compelling plans, offers and approaches to effectively engage this cohort
Leverage Stripe's marketing tech stack and analytics capabilities to drive data-driven decision-making and optimize the field marketing engine

We’re Looking For Someone With

3-5 years of relevant B2B field marketing experience, executing regional strategies including Account Based Marketing
Proven track record of executing marketing programs and events that drive new customer acquisition and pipeline growth
Expertise in developing and executing scaled and targeted multi-channel marketing campaigns across the full funnel
Experience working in both digital and in-person event environments, with a deep understanding of how to integrate event experiences into the buyer's journey
Successful track record of collaborating with Sales teams, including joint planning, lead management, and earning trust as a strategic partner
Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills with ability to synthesize and communicate business health with leadership
Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management capabilities
Startup mentality with a bias for action and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $191,400 - $287,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees
while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D
at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About The Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them
Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves
Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding
Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions
Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast
Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand
Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why
Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context
Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic
Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting
Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you
5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)
You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them
You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next
You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar
You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business
You use AI to get more done than one person normally could
You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

About The Role

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

How will you contribute?

AI-ready data foundation

Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

Data architecture & engineering

Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

Measurement, attribution & analytics

Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership

Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

Data quality, governance & enablement

Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

What will you bring?

5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).
Experience with ELT and orchestration tooling (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow, or similar).
Deep working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, campaign members) and Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform.
Expert BI skills in at least one major platform (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni, Hex), including governed, self-serve dashboard design.
Proven experience designing and governing multi-touch attribution and ABM reporting, and explaining methodology and its limits to non-technical executives.
Practical, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) in analytics work, and a clear point of view on what makes data AI-ready.
Track record of owning an analytics roadmap and influencing senior stakeholders with data.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn complex analysis into a concise business narrative.

Bonus Skills & Experience

Experience building or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based assistants that answer business questions over a governed data model, including accuracy testing.
Python or R for statistical analysis, automation, or modeling (e.g., forecasting, propensity, marketing mix or incrementality analysis).
Experience with Marketo Measure (Bizible) at an administrator or model-design level.
Familiarity with the broader GTM data ecosystem: sales engagement and conversation intelligence (e.g., Salesloft, Outreach, Gong), data enrichment and hygiene (e.g., Clay, RingLead), ABM/intent platforms, and product analytics (e.g., Heap, Amplitude).
Experience supporting annual planning, territory design, pipeline coverage modeling, or retention KPIs.
Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or similar) where data accuracy and auditability are especially important.
Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

$106,000 - $141,000 a year

The above salary range represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting. Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training.

Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

About Our Culture

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

The Opportunity

USAA is looking for an experienced Decision Science Analyst Senior to join the Life Company Data and Analytics team.
USAA Life Company is looking to build on its foundation of exceptional service to grow and serve more members. This role will play a critical part in that growth by delivering actionable insights and optimization recommendations across Paid Social, Paid Search, and emerging AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and Python skills with hands-on experience analyzing paid media performance, audience segmentation, and conducting incrementality testing that improve engagement and acquisition. This individual will leverage advanced analytics, data visualization, and storytelling to connect marketing investments to business outcomes while partnering closely with the channel managers, product marketers, and campaign analysts to drive measurable growth.

This role provides decision support for business areas across the association. This will be responsible for applying mathematical and statistical techniques and/or innovative /quantitative analytical approaches to draw conclusions and make 'insight to action' recommendations to answer business objectives and drive change. The essence of work performed by the Decision Science Analyst involves gathering, manipulating and synthesizing data (e.g., attributes, transactions, behaviors, etc.), models and other relevant information to draw conclusions and make recommendations resulting in implementable strategies.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position will be based on the San Antonio, TX; Charlotte, NC; or Plano, TX. campus
. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Leverages advanced business, analytical and technical knowledge to participate or lead discussions with cross functional teams to understand and collaborate highly complex business objectives and influence solution strategies.
Applies advanced analytical techniques to solve business problems that are typically medium to large scale with significant impact to current and/or future business strategy.
Applies innovative and scientific/quantitative analytical approaches to draw conclusions and make 'insight to action' recommendations to answer the business objective and drive the appropriate change.
Translates recommendation into communication materials to effectively present to various levels of management.
Incorporates visualization techniques to support the relevant points of the analysis and ease the understanding for less technical audiences.
Identifies and gathers the relevant and quality data sources required to fully answer and address the problem for the recommended strategy through testing or exploratory data analysis (EDA).
Integrates/transforms disparate data sources and determines the appropriate data hygiene techniques to apply.
Thoroughly documents assumptions, methodology, validation and testing to facilitate peer reviews and compliance requirements.
Understands and adopts emerging technology that can affect the application of scientific methodologies and/or quantitative analytical approaches to problem resolutions.
Succinctly delivers analysis/findings in a manner that conveys understanding, influences various levels of management, garners support for recommendations, drives business decisions, and influences business strategy.

Remains informed on current data and analytics trends, (Ex: Cloud, Data Mining, Python, Neural Networks, Sensor data, IoT, Streaming/NRT data).

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Rite-Hite, your work makes an impact.
As the global leader in loading dock and door equipment, we design and deliver solutions that keep our customers safe, secure, and productive. Here, you’ll find innovation, stability, and the chance to grow your career as part of a team that’s always looking ahead.

As Product Marketing Manager, you'll be responsible for leading all product marketing efforts for our Automation and Controls portfolio. This includes generating customer and market insights and creating a multi-year marketing strategy and marketing plan across multiple product lines as well as assisting product management to develop winning product roadmaps. You'll identify and drive opportunities for profitable growth with quality, on-time new product launches and for customer loyalty across the lifecycle of installed base products. Key performance indicators include orders, price realization, share gain, customer retention, marketing ROI, utilization of marketing assets, etc.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days onsite at our Milwaukee, WI corporate office.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Customer Focus

Creates and executes an annual customer insight plan in partnership with the insights and operational excellence shared marketing services team to discover unmet needs and utilization trends, validate product concepts, test value propositions and inform pricing decisions
Leads a regular sales and service advisory board to ensure the voice of teams closest to the customer is incorporated into the marketing strategy, plans and tools
Builds direct customer and field understanding through customer visits, Customer Experience Center visits, ride-alongs, sales blitzes, beta sites, advisory groups, trade shows, and other immersion activities.
Defines continuous enhancements to the customer experience and incorporates into the marketing plan
Helps test ideas as part of the standard Rite-Hite innovation process to build a set of high value concepts for product management

Market and Business Insights

In collaboration with the performance marketing team and via analysis, research and problem solving, identifies and continuously drives insights from key external and internal data and trends (e.g., market and industry growth / headwinds / tailwinds, visibility, win/loss, strategic account performance, Salesforce, sales tool utilization, demand generation activities, marketing ROI) for the Automation and Controls portfolio to strengthen business investments and marketing impact

Marketing Strategy

From insights and aligned with the product management priorities and roadmap, creates the marketing strategy for the Automation and Controls portfolio to drive profitable growth (demand generation, funnel acceleration, share gain, price realization)
Provides a market-backed pricing view to the product manager to help inform the final pricing decision; in concert with the performance marketing team conducts external pricing, concept, and voice of customer research studies; monitors pricing trends and leads problem solving workstreams to improve price realization
In collaboration with the distribution and business development teams and product management, leads the definition of the commercial strategy including commercial risk assessment, target customer segments and sales channels

Product Marketing

Aligned with the defined marketing strategy and starting pre-Phase 0 of the new product development process, creates annual and multi-year marketing plans supporting product launches and lifecycle that include branding, value proposition, product and competitive positioning, messaging platform, evidence generation, sales enablement tools and training and demand generation
Owns the development of a relevant, credible and unique value proposition to drive customer delight and profitable growth.
Incorporates competitive analysis from engineering teardowns, war-gaming sessions and product management input.
Works with the performance marketing team and external agencies to develop the messaging platform and positioning; drives a strategic and practical competitive positioning analysis to develop a prescriptive and highly utilized toolset for the commercial team.
Works with the performance marketing team to define the optimum marketing mix (awareness, lead generation/nurturing) and activities (digital, website, SEO, PPC, E-mail, media, print, tradeshow, content marketing, etc.) to maximize the business return on investment for the Automation and Controls portfolio.
Coordinates the development of high quality, consistent and customer-focused marketing assets (sales content, sample kits, proposal support documents, and digital assets) working closely with the performance marketing and product management teams; maintains current materials in approved systems such as the digital asset management platform and Salesforce to ensure high utilization
Identifies budget requirements and creative approaches to ensure execution of the marketing plan; owns a marketing budget and accountable to meet target and optimize spend
Defines the branding requirements for the Automation and Controls portfolio (naming, trademarks, etc.)
Drives execution of the annual marketing plan aligned with the product management timeline
Collaborate with product management and distribution and leads creation of product training

EDUCATION And/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business or similar required.
8+ years related experience in product marketing, product management or related field.
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.
B2B product marketing experience across the complete lifecycle and substantial experience partnering with New Product Development preferred.
MBA or related advanced degree preferred.

Knowledge / Skill Requirements

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Expertise in Upstream / Strategic Product Marketing - gathering insights from voice of customer as well as market analysis, creating value propositions and using them to influence product & experience improvements
Experience working within a stage-gate product development process, collaborating with cross-functional teams including sales & product management
Demonstrated experience developing and measuring high impact marketing programs
Strong analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills; leads formal problem-solving activities (problem definition, data/pareto analysis, root cause, solutioning and measures) for key marketing metrics
Must be able to plan, organize and prioritize work to meet deadlines.
Up to 20% travel may be required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role does not have direct reports.

What We Offer

At Rite-Hite, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work:

Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life and disability insurance. A robust well-being program with an opportunity to receive an extra day off and more.
Financial Security: A strong retirement savings program with 401(k), company match, and profit sharing.
Time for You: Paid holidays, vacation time, and personal/sick days each year.

Join us and build a career where you’re supported – at work and beyond.

Rite-Hite is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. In accordance with VEVRAA, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for protected veterans. We are also committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace
for the safety of our employees and customers.
