In addition to CRM ownership, this position analyzes data across the Company’s marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, Google Analytics, digital advertising, SEO, website activity, email marketing, social media, campaign performance, and other tools used to measure customer engagement and marketing effectiveness. The role partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, IT, Corporate Training, operating subsidiaries, and leadership to turn data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable action to drive revenue growth.

This role can be filled in one of the following Company offices: Houston, TX; Broomall, PA; or Tulsa, OK.

Essential Functions

Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its Core Values.
Represents the Company at all times with high moral standards while adhering to the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
Serves as the primary point of contact, business owner, administrator, and internal champion for the Company’s CRM system.
Leads CRM optimization efforts, including system enhancements, dashboards, reporting, workflows, data integrity, permissions, roles, user access, and overall system usability.
Works closely with business stakeholders across operating subsidiaries, Business Development, Marketing, and IT to identify CRM needs, gather requirements, improve processes, and implement appropriate system solutions.
Leads the CRM Technical Steering Team, including key end users and IT subject matter experts, to advance system functionality, adoption, governance, and long-term value.
Critically analyzes current systems, business processes, workflows, and functional needs; recommends and implements modifications that improve efficiency, data quality, reporting, and user experience.
Maintains CRM data integrity through duplicate detection and resolution, data cleansing, discrepancy reporting, missing or malformed data correction, and improved data governance processes.
Integrates CRM data with other marketing and business tools to provide a more complete view of customer, prospect, campaign, and business development activity.
Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualizations that track KPIs and communicate performance trends to Business Development, Marketing, operating teams, and leadership.
Analyzes performance across marketing channels, including CRM, HubSpot, Google Analytics, website activity, SEO, paid advertising, email marketing, social media, forms, landing pages, and campaign engagement.
Builds and maintains measurement frameworks that evaluate campaign ROI, lead quality, funnel performance, customer journey activity, attribution, conversion rates, and marketing effectiveness.
Develops, manages, and refines lead scoring models in HubSpot using firmographic, demographic, behavioral, web, email, and engagement data.
Defines and monitors criteria for marketing-qualified and sales-qualified leads to help Business Development focus on higher-value prospects and opportunities.
Cleans, organizes, and maintains HubSpot data, including properties, associations, workflows, lists, campaign data, and reporting structures.
Collaborates with Business Development and Marketing to evaluate lead quality, campaign performance, customer engagement, and opportunities for optimization.
Supports Business Development’s Strategic Account Management efforts.
Conducts A/B testing, attribution analysis, ROI analysis, and campaign performance evaluation across digital channels, including email, paid media, web, SEO, and social.
Translates complex data into actionable, executive-level insights by explaining what changed, why it matters, and what actions should be considered.
Supports strategic initiatives by developing analysis, reporting, and recommendations that inform marketing priorities, budget decisions, campaign direction, and business development strategy.
Partners with IT and data teams to improve data collection, system integration, security, scalability, and access to reliable marketing and CRM data.
Works with Corporate Training and internal stakeholders to support user training, adoption, and best practices for CRM and related marketing tools.
Supports Business Development and other functions with CRM, marketing, campaign, and financial data for reports, presentations, planning, and leadership discussions.
Prepares monthly, quarterly, ad hoc, and executive-level reports as required.
Identifies opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, data accessibility, self-service reporting, and overall marketing analytics maturity.
Performs other duties or responsibilities as required or assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.
5+ years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, CRM administration, business intelligence, data analysis, marketing operations, or a related data-driven marketing role.
Strong working knowledge of CRM systems, including configuration of views, dashboards, reports, workflows, data structures, data integrity processes, and external reporting tools.
Demonstrated experience pulling, cleaning, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data from CRM systems and marketing technology platforms.
Proficiency with HubSpot, including reporting, workflows, properties, lists, lead scoring, campaign tracking, and marketing automation data.
Experience with Google Analytics, website analytics, digital campaign reporting, SEO reporting, paid media reporting, and customer journey tracking preferred.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI and DAX; experience with other BI or visualization tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics, lead funnels, campaign attribution, customer engagement, and business development pipeline reporting.
Ability to synthesize large amounts of data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to actively listen, ask thoughtful questions, explain technical information clearly, and develop executive-ready presentations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to work through complex issues from identification to resolution.
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and data quality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, requests, and projects in a fast-paced, changing environment.
Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and work collaboratively across Business Development, Marketing, IT, Operations, Corporate Training, and leadership.

jobs.title: Director, Newsletter & Email Marketing (REMOTE)
jobs.description:
About The Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Our newsletter and email program is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Newsletter & Email Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. If you have run a monetized newsletter program at scale—this is the role for you. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work: building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume newsletter program of 40+ campaigns per week, along with automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization and Partner Performance

Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns-from planning through send and post-send analysis.
Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets - IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops - monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys-activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back-to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub's own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle - including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation - and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

9+ years of hands-on email marketing in a high-volume program, including at least 7 years running a newsletter or email program monetized through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
Experience programming reoccurring newsletters: maintaining send and inventory calendar while balancing paid placements with member experience.
Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack — our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics — across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
Strong command of segmentation, personalization, dynamic content, A/B testing methodologies, plus experience building triggered and automated journeys
Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives — with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart—preferred

Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, newsletter publishing or media/ad-monetization company preferred (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar)
Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape
Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.

Domestic Partner Coverage for all insurance plans

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

Generous Paid Paternity and Maternity Leave Policies
11 Holidays (Including office closed day after Thanksgiving)

Description

The Amazon Leo team is on a mission to create a connected world that will usher in a new era of global productivity and prosperity. Through a constellation of satellites in low earth orbit, we’re going to bring fast Internet to every individual, household, school, and business to empower everyone to collaborate, work, play, invent, and learn from any location, at any time, on any device.

Amazon Leo’s Americas B2B marketing team is looking for an exceptionally talented and passionate individual to create awareness and generate sales-ready leads in the enterprise by leveraging inbound and outbound marketing plays. This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact within an emerging business (and long-term bet) within Amazon.

The ideal candidate is a B2B demand generation expert with deep experience running account-based marketing programs and coordinating inbound and outbound plays against named enterprise accounts. You have worked a target account list with a field sales team, understand how buying committees form in large organizations, and know how to build pipeline in long-cycle, high-consideration deals.

To be successful in this role, you will need to develop vertical expertise across Leo’s priority enterprise industries to produce account-specific campaigns, and partner closely with field sellers, SDRs, and Central Marketing to deliver coordinated insight-driven campaigns that move buying committees from awareness to sales-ready engagement.

Key job responsibilities

Enterprise Demand Generation & ABM

Own and execute Leo’s North America enterprise ABM motion, orchestrating targeted account plays across inbound and outbound channels to build pipeline within named accounts across priority verticals, partnering closely with field sellers and SDRs to coordinate account buying committee engagement, and to automate sales handoff.
Develop and manage integrated campaign calendars aligned to Leo’s enterprise GTM milestones, service availability expansions, key industry events, and EBC programming—ensuring marketing plays are sequenced to amplify field sales moments rather than run in parallel.
Build and manage enterprise nurture programs in Marketo that move engaged accounts from awareness to sales-ready status, including vertical-specific nurture tracks, EBC follow-up sequences, and post-event re-engagement, all with clearly defined MQA thresholds and handoff criteria co-developed with sales.
Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the enterprise field sales team to align campaign calendars to account pursuit timelines, co-developing vertical-specific messaging and outbound sequences with SDRs, and ensuring marketing investment is concentrated on accounts where sales is actively engaged.
Drive inbound demand capture by briefing and directing Central Marketing channel owners on Leo’s enterprise targeting inputs (account lists, vertical personas, intent signals) to activate paid social (LinkedIn), content syndication, SEM, programmatic display, and webinar programs against named account clusters and buying committees.

Scale Impact Through AI and Intelligent Automation

Design and deploy AI-powered workflows that operationalize Leo's ABM motion at scale, from intent signal ingestion and account prioritization to personalized content assembly and campaign activation across target verticals.
Use AI agents to compress the time between insight and action: automate account research, buying committee mapping, and outbound sequence personalization so sellers and marketers spend time on high-judgment work, not repeatable tasks.
Treat Leo's marketing stack like a high-performance engine: frequently instrument, test, tune, and examine the components (Demandbase, MAP, CRM, generative AI) to increase account coverage and pipeline velocity through intelligent tooling.
Document and codify what works so that ABM plays, agent workflows, and campaign frameworks become repeatable infrastructure the broader Leo marketing team can build on globally.

Measurement & Reporting

Define and own the enterprise demand gen measurement framework anchored on Marketing Qualified Accounts (MQAs), influenced pipeline value, account coverage by tier and vertical, and pipeline velocity, then run structured experiments to continuously improve program performance, giving leadership a clear view of what’s working and where to invest next.
Build and maintain an enterprise demand gen performance dashboard that connects account-level campaign activity to pipeline outcomes, translating raw data into actionable insights for field sales, SDR leadership, and the broader North America marketing team.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
6+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or account-based marketing, with at least 2 years operating in an enterprise GTM motion with a field sales team and named account targets.
Understanding of enterprise ABM mechanics and the tools that support them (like Demandbase), intent signal interpretation, account scoring, and buying committee mapping, well enough to brief, direct, and optimize program performance even when not directly instrumenting every tool.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work across account-level data sources (Salesforce, MAP dashboards) to surface account engagement signals, measure pipeline influence, and make data-driven program decisions.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred) for building and managing enterprise nurture programs, including vertical-specific email sequences, decision-tree logic, account-level scoring thresholds, and MQA handoff triggers integrated with Salesforce.
Demonstrated ability to define enterprise demand gen KPIs (MQAs, account coverage, pipeline influence, velocity), interpret multi-touch attribution data, and translate program performance into actionable recommendations for both marketing and sales leadership.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write compelling campaign briefs, creative direction, and executive-ready performance summaries.
Experience marketing to enterprise or strategic accounts in satellite, telecommunications, broadband, cloud infrastructure, or industrial technology market segments, with familiarity with the operational and procurement complexity of large organizational buyers.
Experience working in both a hyperscaler business and an early-stage (launch-phase) business where strategy is actively being built rather than inherited.
Proven ability to communicate performance results and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Marketing Cloud Next (Public Sector)
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Marketing Cloud Next is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

This role specializes in guiding organizations through seamless migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms—including Granicus GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement —to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. By identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, the CSM strategically aligns solutions with the customer’s top priorities, projects, and goals.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Core Technical Skills Required

Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform. Able to architect solutions end-to-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to Marketing Cloud Next — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect’s technical approach.
Subscriber Data Model & Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement ) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to Marketing Cloud Next equivalents.
Journey & Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and priortize complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Flow native design patterns.
Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post-migration deliverability strategy.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Marketing Cloud Next is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Category Marketing, AWS Cross Category Marketing
jobs.description:
Description

AWS is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the Cross-Category Services marketing team. This role owns the marketing strategy and execution for a portfolio of services that help AWS customers accelerate their cloud transformations and achieve long-term success: AWS Training & Certification, AWS Support, AWS Professional Services, and AWS Marketplace & Partner Services.

These services represent a critical part of the AWS customer journey — from building skills and getting expert guidance, to finding and deploying third-party solutions, to ensuring ongoing operational excellence. Together they generate billions in revenue.

As the leader of this team, you will build and manage a high-performing team of product marketers, develop differentiated positioning and messaging for each portfolio, drive customer insights that inform marketing strategy, and serve as the connective tissue between diverse business stakeholders who have different operating rhythms, go-to-market motions, and customer audiences.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complexity — someone who can context-switch fluidly across businesses while maintaining strategic coherence, who builds trust with senior stakeholders through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery.

Key job responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop and own the marketing strategy for Training & Certification, Support, Professional Services, and Marketplace — including positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market plans
Synthesize customer insights, market data, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and shape strategy across all four businesses
Drive differentiated messaging that connects each service to the broader AWS customer success narrative — helping customers understand how these services accelerate transformation
Lead product launch strategies and associated plans, including naming, target audience definition, content development, and marketing vehicle selection
Continuously measure and optimize marketing performance, establishing KPIs and mechanisms for each portfolio

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the primary marketing partner to four distinct business leadership teams, each with different operating rhythms, customer segments, and go-to-market motions
Build deep trust with VP and Director-level stakeholders across product, sales, professional services, and partner organizations through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery
Navigate competing priorities and resource constraints across portfolios — making principled trade-off decisions and communicating them transparently

People Management & Team Building

Build, lead, and develop a team of product and general marketing professionals spanning multiple portfolios and locations
Hire, retain, and grow top marketing talent
Resource the team effectively across portfolios, making staffing recommendations aligned to business priority and impact

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

10+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience managing teams
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Knowledge of B2B procurement processes
Experience working with executive leadership in large organizations

Bloomingdale’s makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire our customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. Our colleagues are passionate, driven, entrepreneurial and collaborative, while having a lot of fun along the way.

Job Overview

The Marketing and Special Events Coordinator assists in the execution of Bloomingdale’s Integrated Marketing campaigns through in-store events and activations. This colleague has involvement with their internal store partners and vendor partners, as well as external community partners and organizations to drive brand awareness and customer acquisition to positively impact market share on a localized level. The Coordinator will play a critical role in representing the Bloomingdale’s brand in a positive, professional way that enhances our company’s reputation and promotes our business objectives.

Pursues localized opportunities in alignment with Marketing and Special Events Senior Manager and store leadership to cultivate customers and build sales. Supports local accelerated growth of priority businesses with event intensification that builds store animation and experience.

Partner with local client teams to monitors frequency of visits, engagement and spend as it relates to engagement with eventing.
Collaborates with the Central Earned Media team to enhance any local media plans, securing publicity and partnering with brand-appropriate social media influencers and bloggers.
Guides General Manager(s) as to productive involvement in outside organizations and events.
Leverages corporate philanthropy giving programs to maximize community impact and fundraising.
May be called upon as point person for external communication locally.

Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

jobs.description:
Hiring Department

UMKC Division of Strategic Marketing and Communications

Job Description

The Strategic Communications Assistant Director of Web Services provides strategic oversight of all web services provided by UMKC’s division of Strategic Marketing and Communications (MCOM). This leadership role sits at the intersection of marketing, information technology, and institutional governance, requiring close relationships with campus and system partners. By setting a vision and standards for the university’s overall web presence, this position guides their team to ensure the website is following best practices and provides a usable and accessible experience for all web visitors.

Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities

Supervise, develop and guide MCOM’s web team, including front-end developers, web editors and an intern, and advocate for additional support as necessary;
Establish project processes and priorities, including staffing and roadmaps, and work with direct reports to ensure projects are completed on time, adjusting for shifts in priority as they arise;
Advise leadership on web strategies and initiatives that support UMKC’s strategic goals and oversee implementation of these strategies;
Provide guidance to web developers in improving the university's website structure, using data-driven decision-making and ensuring ensure legal compliance on digital accessibility;
Oversee charge back model for web services, estimating work, recommending improvements and using the revenue to budget for technology upgrades and overflow work.
Support the university’s content strategy, curation, and governance processes and Serve as the subject matter expert on web best practices;
Monitor emerging technologies and best practices and recommend changes to digital policies and guidelines in cooperation with Information Services and campus leadership;
Guide the web team through collaboration with designers, developers, web editors and content owners to facilitate alignment on design, code and site functionality;
Identify tools to support web team efforts, and assist with integrations involving external software partners to enhance website functionality and user experience;
Monitor analytics collection for the website and provide reports for web products and services;
Build and maintain strong relationships with key partners in IT and on the other campuses in the university system;
Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience and at least 4 years of experience from which comparable knowledge and skills can be acquired is necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

Successful candidates will be collaborative leaders who can adapt to a changing environment and approach process and budget challenges with innovative thinking.

5+ years of experience supervising a team and developing their potential.
Experience in front-end development, website management or a related field desired, especially in managing websites in Cascade Server and WordPress.
Understanding of Google Analytics and Tag Manager, and experience interpreting analytics to make recommendations for website optimization.
Familiarity with crafting presentations/reports for leadership and experience presenting to groups about technical topics a plus.
Knowledge of SEO best practices and familiarity.
Experience working in a marketing and/or communications environment, particularly in a university setting, would be a plus.
Advanced communication, organization, and project management skills preferred.

jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

USAA is looking for an experienced Decision Science Analyst Senior to join the Life Company Data and Analytics team.
USAA Life Company is looking to build on its foundation of exceptional service to grow and serve more members. This role will play a critical part in that growth by delivering actionable insights and optimization recommendations across Paid Social, Paid Search, and emerging AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and Python skills with hands-on experience analyzing paid media performance, audience segmentation, and conducting incrementality testing that improve engagement and acquisition. This individual will leverage advanced analytics, data visualization, and storytelling to connect marketing investments to business outcomes while partnering closely with the channel managers, product marketers, and campaign analysts to drive measurable growth.

This role provides decision support for business areas across the association. This will be responsible for applying mathematical and statistical techniques and/or innovative /quantitative analytical approaches to draw conclusions and make 'insight to action' recommendations to answer business objectives and drive change. The essence of work performed by the Decision Science Analyst involves gathering, manipulating and synthesizing data (e.g., attributes, transactions, behaviors, etc.), models and other relevant information to draw conclusions and make recommendations resulting in implementable strategies.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position will be based on the San Antonio, TX; Charlotte, NC; or Plano, TX. campus
. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Leverages advanced business, analytical and technical knowledge to participate or lead discussions with cross functional teams to understand and collaborate highly complex business objectives and influence solution strategies.
Applies advanced analytical techniques to solve business problems that are typically medium to large scale with significant impact to current and/or future business strategy.
Applies innovative and scientific/quantitative analytical approaches to draw conclusions and make 'insight to action' recommendations to answer the business objective and drive the appropriate change.
Translates recommendation into communication materials to effectively present to various levels of management.
Incorporates visualization techniques to support the relevant points of the analysis and ease the understanding for less technical audiences.
Identifies and gathers the relevant and quality data sources required to fully answer and address the problem for the recommended strategy through testing or exploratory data analysis (EDA).
Integrates/transforms disparate data sources and determines the appropriate data hygiene techniques to apply.
Thoroughly documents assumptions, methodology, validation and testing to facilitate peer reviews and compliance requirements.
Understands and adopts emerging technology that can affect the application of scientific methodologies and/or quantitative analytical approaches to problem resolutions.
Succinctly delivers analysis/findings in a manner that conveys understanding, influences various levels of management, garners support for recommendations, drives business decisions, and influences business strategy.
Provides subject matter expertise in operationalizing recommendations.
Remains informed on current data and analytics trends, (Ex: Cloud, Data Mining, Python, Neural Networks, Sensor data, IoT, Streaming/NRT data).
Identifies opportunities to continue to learn in the data and analytics space, whether informal (e.g., Coursera, Udemy, Kaggle, Code Up, etc.) or formal (e.g. Certifications or advanced coursework).
Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science, or a business or quantitative field OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree. (Total of 10 years of experience without bachelor’s degree)
6 years of data & analytics experience OR a minimum of 4 years of data & analytics experience and up to 2 years of progressive functional business relevant experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e. Life Insurance, Marketing etc.) for a total of 6 years combined experience OR Advanced degree in quantitative analytics field such as Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science or other quantitative discipline and 4 years of experience in data/analytics or functional business experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e. Life Insurance, Marketing, etc.).
Demonstrates advanced skills in mathematical and statistical techniques and approaches used to drive fact-based decision-making.
Advanced knowledge of data analysis tools, data visualization, developing analysis queries and procedures in SQL, SAS, BI tools or other analysis software, and relevant industry data & methods and ability to connect external insights to business problems.
Experience with new and emerging data sets, and incorporation (data wrangling, data munging) into new insights.

What Sets You Apart

US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner.
5+ years of experience using SQL and Python to analyze data, develop insights, and support marketing decision-making.
3+ years of experience optimizing paid social campaigns through audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget management, retargeting, and performance analysis.
3+ years of experience optimizing paid search campaigns through keyword strategy, query analysis, bidding, and customer acquisition performance measurement.
Knowledge of AI-powered search and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), including emerging search behaviors and opportunities to improve brand visibility and consumer intent capture.
Experience with audience segmentation, creative testing, and influencer/creator performance analysis, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
Experience with experimentation and measurement, including A/B testing, incrementality studies, and control vs. test frameworks to evaluate marketing effectiveness.
Strong analytics, data visualization, and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect paid media performance to website engagement and conversion outcomes. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Adobe Analytics, Google Ads, Bing Ads, SA360, Floodlight tags, and attribution tools.

Description

Position Title:

Social Media Coordinator-HSO Digital and Social Media-Mount Sinai Hospital-Hybrid-Full Time-Days

Position Summary

The Digital and Social Media Coordinator is responsible for executing the Mount Sinai Health System’s social media strategy across key channels—including Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Facebook, and Threads. The successful candidate will work closely with key members of the Social Media Department to translate complex medical and research concepts into clear, compelling social media content. This role will be instrumental in expanding our digital audience and increasing our overall brand presence.

Responsibilities

Conceptualize, write, and produce daily multi-platform content across primary channels for both the Mount Sinai Health System and the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, translating complex clinical data, medical research breakthroughs, and academic achievements into accessible, engaging public health communications.
Produce short-form vertical video content (e.g., Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) highlighting patient stories, clinical innovations, student/faculty spotlights, and research milestones.
Actively monitor brand mentions, patient inquiries, and trending medical/academic discussions to foster positive community engagement while strictly adhering to HIPAA and institutional privacy guidelines.
Working with other members of the team, track, analyze, and report on key metrics across both health system and medical school channels to refine overall strategy.
Utilize current social media best practices, platform feature updates, and modern workflow/AI tools (e.g., caption generation, asset optimization) to increase execution efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.
Partner closely with internal communications, research teams, marketing, and academic departments to align social media campaigns with broader institutional goals.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree or greater preferred, or combination of applicable experience and education

2-3+ years’ experience in social media marketing required; preferably in social media content production, graphic design, presentation design, and analytics.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent project management and organizational skills.
Knowledge of social media platforms, trends and best practices.
Experience with social media management tools and analytic platforms.
Ability to supervise and train employees, to include organizing, scheduling work assignments.

Position Summary

The Special Olympics Ohio (SOOH) Senior Manager, Marketing and Communications will report directly to the Vice President, Marketing and Communications. This position will help lead the planning and execution of integrated marketing and communications strategies that increase awareness, strengthen statewide engagement, and promote the mission, programs, athletes, and events of Special Olympics Ohio.

The Senior Manager will serve as a hands-on leader across storytelling, digital marketing, social media, media relations, brand management, website content, internal communications, and performance measurement. The role will work collaboratively across departments and regions to translate organizational priorities into clear, compelling, and measurable communications.

Essential Job Functions

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.)

Partner with the Vice President to develop and implement annual marketing and communications strategies, campaigns, calendars, goals, and performance measures.

Strategic Communications & Marketing

Support development and execution of statewide marketing and communications initiatives.
Manage annual communications calendars aligned with organizational priorities and major events.
Develop integrated campaigns that increase awareness, engagement, participation, volunteerism, and support.
Partner with departments across the organization to identify strategic communication opportunities.
Ensure messaging consistency across all channels and audiences.

Storytelling & Content Strategy

·       Lead development and management of a statewide storytelling program.

·       Identify and capture compelling athlete, volunteer, coach, family, donor, and partner stories.

·       Create / Develop content for digital, print, email, video, social media, and earned media channels.

·       Manage editorial planning and content calendars.

·       Maintain and grow a library of mission-focused content assets.

Digital Marketing & Social Media

Oversee day-to-day management of social media platforms and digital campaigns.
Develop and execute content strategies that increase engagement and audience growth.
Support website content management and optimization.
Monitor digital performance and recommend improvements based on analytics.
Identify emerging digital trends and opportunities for audience growth.

Media Relations & Public Relations

Build and maintain relationships with media outlets across Ohio.
Develop media pitches, press releases, talking points, and media kits.
Coordinate earned media opportunities surrounding major events, campaigns, and athlete stories.
Track and report on media coverage and public relations outcomes.
Support spokesperson preparation and media interview coordination.

Brand Management

Ensure compliance with organizational brand standards and guidelines.
Develop communication toolkits, templates, and messaging resources.
Provide consultation and communications support to regional teams and community based programs.
Assist in maintaining a consistent voice and visual identity across channels.

Internal Communications

Support internal communication initiatives that enhance alignment and engagement.
Develop content for staff, volunteers, board members, and organizational stakeholders.
Assist with communication planning for organizational announcements and initiatives.
Contribute to efforts that improve communication flow across departments and regions.

Analytics & Performance Measurement

Monitor and analyze marketing and communications performance metrics.
Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
Track media coverage, website performance, social engagement, email effectiveness, and campaign outcomes.
Use data and audience insights to inform future communications strategies.

Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills

·   Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, public relations, journalism, graphic design, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

·   Five to seven years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, communications, public relations, digital marketing, or a related field; nonprofit or mission-driven experience preferred.

·   Demonstrated ability to translate organizational goals into integrated communications plans, campaigns, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

·   Exceptional writing, editing, interviewing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt content for different audiences and channels.

·   Experience managing social media platforms, digital content, email marketing, website content, and communications calendars.

·   Working knowledge of media relations, including pitching, press material development, interview coordination, and coverage tracking.

·   Strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and maintain exceptional attention to detail.

·   Proficiency with Microsoft Office products and experience with content creation, design, publishing, analytics, and project-management tools; Canva and Adobe experience preferred.

·   Experience with photography, videography, short-form video, or creative vendor management preferred.

·   Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at varying levels of seniority.

·   High energy and passion for the Special Olympics mission, inclusion, and athlete-centered storytelling.

·   Excellent written, oral, interpersonal, and receptive communication skills.

·   Must be willing to travel independently to support periodic events throughout the state.

·   Must be comfortable behind a camera for photography and videography initiatives.

Miscellaneous Information

·   Position is full-time, exempt.

·   Days/hours of work: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

·   Evening and weekend work is required as position demands and may at times be extensive.

·   Independent in-state travel is required, including independent overnight and weekend travel as an essential function of the position.

·   Required to maintain and provide proof of a valid, current state driver’s license and automobile property and casualty insurance at all times.

Other Duties

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

new_jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
new_jobs.description:
Knak Is a Mission-driven Company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. To have the biggest impact on the world, we stay focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering marketers to be creative .

That’s why Knak exists.

In a world where AI has made everyone a creator, Knak helps marketers turn ideas into on-brand, high-performing campaigns at scale. The world's most AI-forward companies, including Meta, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Vercel, Notion and Stripe, use Knak as their agentic marketing production layer.

Here's what they and our investor Insight Partners figured out: creation got easy, but that’s making production harder. Every new idea and brief still has to be built, versioned, checked, approved, and shipped across every channel, and that work runs on handoffs, review cycles, and a lot of copy-paste. That middle stretch of the marketing stack has no system, no standard, and no owner.

Knak is the flexible factory for that work. Our customers set the brand rules, choose the tools that feed in and the platforms that send, and decide where AI does the work and where people do. We handle the repeatable parts, so marketers get their time back for the parts that aren't.

We're built by marketers, for marketers. We started with email because it's the hardest channel to get right and where many campaigns win or lose. Now we're bringing that same production discipline to every channel our customers use.

For a CMO, that's a rare seat: the chance to define a category, not just compete in one. You get to market a marketing product to marketers and collaborate with a CEO who is a Marketer himself and truly understands Marketing, brand and the value it brings.

Oh, and we have a bit of fun while doing it, too!

The Role

Knak is looking for a builder CMO to lead our next stage of growth. As a fast-growing B2B SaaS company, redefining how enterprise marketing teams produce campaigns in the AI era.

This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a finished marketing machine. We need a leader who can build the machine - someone who has created pipeline, built teams, collaborated and built strong relationships with Sales, developed brands and operated successfully through ambiguity and rapid change.
