new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Samsung Electronics America, Inc. (SEA), the U.S. Sales and Marketing subsidiary, is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. For more than four decades, Samsung has driven innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity across the United States—investing over $100 billion and employing more than 20,000 people nationwide. By integrating our large portfolio of products, services and AI technology, we’re creating smarter, sustainable and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. SEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager of B2B CRM & Marketing Automation to lead the evolution of our digital customer engagement, marketing automation, and lead management capabilities. This role will help architect the digital demand journey—connecting media, content, web experiences, lead capture, marketing automation, CRM, and sales activation into an integrated B2B growth engine. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong operational expertise and understands how digital experiences work together to attract prospects, capture demand, nurture relationships, identify buying signals, and ultimately generate pipeline.

This leader will partner closely with Sales, Integrated Marketing, Digital, Creative, Analytics, Product Marketing, Technology, and external partners to develop scalable customer journeys that improve engagement, strengthen marketing-to-sales connectivity, and deliver measurable business impact. This is an opportunity for a builder—someone who can optimize today’s programs while helping design the capabilities, processes, technology, and customer experiences required to support future B2B growth.

Role And Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

CRM, Lifecycle & Customer Engagement Strategy

Participate in CRM Governance Council for planning and coordination across SEA lines of business. Ensure compliance with all guidelines and provide briefs and analysis for Council review.
Own and evolve the B2B CRM and marketing automation strategy across the customer engagement journey.
Develop scalable lifecycle and nurture strategies aligned to customer needs, buying stages, business priorities, and sales motions.
Build segmentation, personalization, and next-best-action approaches that increase customer relevance and accelerate progression through the funnel.
Identify gaps and opportunities across the customer journey and translate them into actionable programs, capabilities, and technology improvements.
Develop strategies for lead capture, qualification, scoring, routing, nurture, recycling, re-engagement, and sales activation.
Continuously explore new approaches to customer engagement, including emerging automation, AI, personalization, and journey orchestration capabilities.

Digital Customer Journey & Conversion Experience

Own and continuously improve the digital pathways that move B2B prospects from awareness and engagement through lead capture, nurture, sales engagement, and conversion.
Partner across Integrated Marketing, Digital, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, and Sales to develop connected experiences across websites, landing pages, digital advertising, content, email, events, and other customer touchpoints- translating campaign engagement into scalable nurture and conversion programs.
Develop and optimize high-performing landing pages, lead-capture experiences, calls-to-action, forms, and conversion pathways that translate marketing engagement into identifiable demand.
Use behavioral and conversion data to identify friction within the digital journey and recommend improvements to content, UX, personalization, navigation, conversion paths, and nurture experiences.
Partner with creative and content teams to identify the assets needed to support customer progression, including digital advertising, solution content, thought leadership, case studies, gated and ungated content, and sales enablement experiences.
Champion experimentation through A/B testing, personalization, dynamic content, progressive profiling, journey optimization, and emerging AI-enabled experiences.

Demand Generation & Pipeline Acceleration

Partner with Sales and Sales Operations to strengthen marketing-to-sales handoffs and improve lead follow-up, acceptance, conversion, and pipeline velocity.
Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and prioritize prospects based on fit, intent, engagement, and buying behavior.
Establish clear measurement frameworks connecting CRM and digital engagement programs to business outcomes including engagement, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline, conversion, and revenue.

Marketing Automation, Technology & Data

Serve as a business owner and subject matter expert for B2B marketing automation, CRM, lead management, and related customer engagement capabilities.
Translate business and customer requirements into scalable marketing technology solutions and workflows.
Partner with technology, analytics, and platform teams to improve integrations, data quality, audience management, campaign orchestration, identity resolution, and measurement.
Ensure customer and behavioral data can be effectively activated across marketing programs and surfaced to Sales where appropriate.
Evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities that can improve marketing effectiveness, customer experience, operational efficiency, and sales connectivity.
Establish governance, documentation, testing, quality assurance, and operational standards for CRM and automated marketing programs.

Analytics, Optimization & Innovation

Develop reporting and performance frameworks that provide actionable insights into customer behavior, funnel progression, campaign effectiveness, and pipeline contribution.
Use data and experimentation to continually improve engagement, conversion, customer experience, and business outcomes.

new_jobs.description:
ABOUT ROOTSTOCK

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.

Please, no agencies/recruiters.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own paid performance.
Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.

Drive technical SEO and conversion.
Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.

Build in Claude Code.
Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.

Measure what works.
Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.

Shape AI and review-site discoverability.
Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.

Support content and campaigns.
Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-based outbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, the ability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more than checking every box.

Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution

Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results

A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting

Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization

An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct

A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers

Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearly

NICE TO HAVE

Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients

A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup

Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software

Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels

Experience with G2 or other product review platforms

Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

FIRST 90 DAYS

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

Day 30:
Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.

Day 60:
Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.

Day 90:
Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

Hiring Managers

CRO/Executive

Case study/Panel interview

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Description

Marketing at Gensler is where strong marketers become great ones, and the Marketing Coordinator role is where that arc begins. We're looking for a candidate who is ready to take on real ownership, learn fast, and grow inside one of the largest, most experienced marketing teams in the industry, someone whose curiosity, instincts, and skillset are starting to outpace their current role.

Our marketers are valued not only for what they produce, but for what they bring to the table: the questions they ask, the ideas they raise, the relationships they build, and the way they sharpen how we tell our story. The Marketing Coordinator role is where those instincts start to take shape, alongside the production fluency, design judgment, and strategic thinking that define a strong marketer.

As a Marketing Coordinator in our Work sector, you will partner with senior marketers, principals, designers, and strategists on pursuits across financial services, professional services, legal, technology, media, and other workplace-driven industries for some of the most influential organizations in New York and beyond.

This role is part producer, part collaborator, part student of the craft. You will own the start-to-end production of marketing collateral and proposal sections, contribute to pursuit planning, and learn directly from marketers who shape how Gensler competes.

You will work with a global network of marketers, based out of the largest design office in the world, with access to Gensler's research and thought leadership platforms — including the firm's Workplace Survey and global benchmarking data — to ground your work in real insight. The work is fast-paced and rarely the same twice: a flagship financial services headquarters one week, a global media campus the next, an AI hub the week after.

As you progress, you will develop the strategic instincts, design fluency, production rigor, and relationship range to move from supporting pursuits to helping shape them.

You'll join one of the firm's most experienced marketing teams supporting work across 33 practice areas. The team brings a high level of craft, rigor, and generosity to the work. You'll work closely with them, collaborate daily, and build the kind of dynamic that only forms inside a team that takes its work seriously. Every Coordinator is paired with a senior marketer for the first six months to accelerate ramp-up and ensure direct mentorship from day one.

Within 90 days, you'll be producing high-quality proposal sections and collateral with minimal revisions, oriented to studio workflows and brand standards. By six months, you'll be a trusted production partner to senior marketers, owning end-to-end execution on mid-size pursuits. By twelve months, you'll be contributing to pursuit strategy decisions and identified for stretch projects and increased ownership.

At Gensler, we bring the scale, complexity, and support to help strong marketers specialize, lead, or build new professional lanes where their interests, capabilities, and the firm's needs intersect.

Your Role

You've spent the last few years building real skills: proposal production, design, writing, project management. You can handle volume. You’re the one who catches the typo on page 47. You know how to make something look good and read well, and you want deeper involvement in pursuit strategy.

You're a strong writer with sharp visual instincts and a natural eye for detail. You're calm under pressure because you've been there — fast turnarounds, multiple deliverables, and last-minute pivots.

You ask smart questions, raise your hand when you need help, and just as readily raise it when you see a way to make something better. You're curious about new tools and techniques, alert to where technology can give the team an edge and are energized by figuring out smarter ways to work.

This isn't a fit for someone content to stay in a narrow production lane. It's a fit for someone who wants to grow into a real marketing leader.

What You Will Do

End-to-end production of marketing collateral, BD assets, and proposal sections - taking real responsibility, not just executing tasks
Partnership with marketing specialists and leaders on proposal development, design, and writing in alignment with Gensler's brand standards
Contribution to pursuit planning and win strategy conversations
Multiple parallel projects and deadlines, with the discipline to manage them without sacrificing quality
Marketing resources — resumes, case stories, project libraries — kept current, accurate, and trusted
Deep familiarity with Gensler's portfolio, practice areas, and firm-wide capabilities
Special projects that elevate the quality of our marketing output

Your Qualifications

4+ years of marketing or communications experience
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Journalism, Business, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field
Proficiency in Adobe InDesign
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Strong graphic design and visual communication skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines
Learning mindset — curious about emerging tools and technologies, open to new ways of working, and motivated to keep growing
Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, or Premiere Pro
Familiarity with Google Slides, Miro, or AI-enabled creative/workflow tools
Experience at an architecture, interior design, or AEC firm is a plus

To be considered, please submit a cover letter, resume, and 2–3 work samples or a portfolio.
Your cover letter should address the key characteristics highlighted in this position description and communicate why your skillset, experience, and background make you a strong fit for this role.

Gensler's NYC marketing team is actively growing. We are considering candidates across multiple levels and encourage you to apply to the role that best matches your experience. If you're between levels or unsure, apply to either and we will evaluate fit holistically.

The base salary range will be estimated between $70,000 - $80,000. Gensler’s total compensation package is multi-layered and includes a base salary, two annual bonuses paid in December and June. To learn more about our compensation philosophy and full benefits offerings, please visit Great People, Great Rewards | Gensler **

Life at Gensler

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Awareness Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability, wellness programs, flex spending, paid holidays, and paid time off. We also offer a 401k, profit sharing, employee stock ownership, and twice annual bonus opportunities. Our annual base salary range has been established based on local markets.

As part of the firm’s commitment to licensure and professional development, Gensler offers reimbursement for certain professional licenses and associated renewals and exam fees. In addition, we reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

Comfort with data tools and willingness to learn Snowflake-specific platforms (Cortex, Streamlit, SQL basics) — you don't need to be an engineer, but you should be eager to build

new_jobs.description:
About the Company

WHEN Justice is a crowdsourcing platform democratizing litigation funding. We enable the public to directly fund strategic litigation that protects the environment, strengthens food safety standards, and defends consumer rights. Our mission is to hold accountable those who put power and profit before people, communities, and the planet we share. Unlike traditional legal advocacy organizations, our model puts the public at the center. Ordinary people fund the cases, follow their progress, and see the real-world impact of holding powerful actors accountable. Growing that community of backers is how we take on more cases, sustain them longer, and win.

About the Role

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Lead to build and scale the engine that brings people to WHEN Justice, turns them into backers, and keeps them coming back. This is a hands-on role for someone who runs experiments quickly, measures them honestly, and uses AI to do work that would usually take a full team. Each case we launch is effectively a new product, with its own story, audience, and funding goal. Your job is to build a repeatable launch playbook: find the right audiences, test the message, convert interest into funding, and turn first-time backers into people who support case after case. You will tie campaigns to real case milestones, such as filings, rulings, and settlements, so our community grows alongside the work. Our cases are active litigation, so accuracy is not optional. Every claim in an ad, email, or landing page has to be true and defensible. You will work closely with our attorneys, and we expect you to treat legal review as part of the craft, not friction. Trust is the product. We are looking for someone with the judgment to grow fast without cutting corners. We are a lean organization, and AI sits at the center of this role. We expect you to build real workflows, not just use a chatbot: creative and copy variation pipelines, audience segmentation, lifecycle personalization, prospect and partner research, and content built to surface in AI-driven search as well as traditional search. The Growth Marketing Lead reports to the Executive Director and works closely with legal, communications, development, and our product and engineering partners.

Responsibilities

Own the full growth funnel, from first visit through first contribution, repeat support, and referral
Design and run a steady cadence of experiments across channels, creative, landing pages, and lifecycle messaging, with sound test design and clear decision rules

Measure true incrementality through holdout, geo, and lift testing rather than relying on platform-reported attribution
Build a repeatable launch playbook for new cases, including audience targeting, messaging, pacing, and milestone-driven campaigns
Run paid acquisition across social, search, and emerging channels with disciplined budget management and blended CAC targets
Own email, SMS, and community programs that convert first-time backers into repeat supporters
Build AI-powered workflows for creative production, segmentation, personalization, and research, and document them so the team can use them
Grow organic reach through SEO, AI search visibility, partnerships, creators, and earned-media tie-ins
Partner with attorneys to make sure every public claim about a case is accurate and appropriately framed
Report growth metrics, experiment results, and recommendations to leadership and the board

Experiments they designed and ran, with the baseline, the change, the result, and what they did next, including at least one that failed
AI workflows they personally built, what they replaced, and the measurable effect
How they determined whether a channel was actually driving growth or just getting credit for it

In addition:

new_jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
new_jobs.description:
Build the Marketing Engine Behind the Next Generation of Fundraising

Inspire.World | Remote, U.S. | Executive Leadership Team | Employee-owned

The Opportunity - CMO with Equity Buy-in

What if everyday commerce could become an always-on engine for fundraising?

That's what we're building at Inspire.World.

We are creating a next-generation platform that connects institutions, communities, merchants and consumers—turning digital engagement, commerce, promotions and loyalty into sustainable fundraising.

Our vision is ambitious: build a Community Activation Network that can fundamentally change how schools, youth organizations, colleges, faith communities, nonprofits and public media organizations generate support.

We're looking for an entrepreneurial Chief Marketing Officer to help make that vision a reality.

This isn't a traditional CMO role.

You won't simply oversee branding or lead generation. You'll build the marketing engine that drives our company, our vertical expansion and a significant portion of the value we create for our customers.

And we're looking for someone who wants to be more than an executive.

We want an operator who wants to become an owner and long-term partner in the business.

What You'll Own

As CMO, you'll lead four interconnected areas:

1. Market Strategy & Growth

Define our positioning, segmentation and go-to-market strategy across multiple verticals.
Determine where and how we enter new markets—and how we turn individual vertical opportunities into a scalable platform strategy.
Build the demand engine across digital, content, partnerships, social and other channels.
Establish the metrics, processes and discipline required to create predictable pipeline and revenue growth.
Partner with executive leadership and Business Development on strategic, partner-led distribution.

2. Performance Marketing & AI

Own CAC, conversion economics, pipeline contribution and marketing ROI.
Build a data-driven, experimentation-focused marketing organization.
Make AI a fundamental part of how we create content, analyze markets, execute campaigns and reach consumers.
Establish AEO/answer-engine optimization and AI-driven discoverability as emerging growth channels.
Help ensure that when consumers turn to AI to solve a fundraising or community-commerce need, Inspire.World is part of the answer.

3. Client Campaign Services

Our marketing organization doesn't just market Inspire.World—it also markets on behalf of our customers.

You'll build and lead the team responsible for client campaigns across:

Content and creative
Social media
Email and SMS
Merchant offers and promotions
Campaign execution and optimization
Performance reporting

You'll develop the systems, technology, automation and AI capabilities required to scale this service from dozens to thousands of campaigns without creating linear headcount growth.

4. Brand & Market Leadership

Own the Inspire.World brand, messaging and market narrative.
Develop differentiated positioning for institutions, supporters, merchants and partners.
Build the proof points, case studies and trust signals required to accelerate institutional adoption.
Lead our digital presence and conversion strategy.
Build and manage the agencies, technology partners and resources required to accelerate growth.
The Executive We're Looking For

You're likely a strong fit if you:

Have 10–15+ years of digital-first marketing leadership, including significant VP/CMO-level experience.
Have scaled marketing within a B2B SaaS, marketplace, B2B2C or DTC platform environment.
Have experience building GTM strategies across multiple verticals or customer segments.
Personally understand CAC/LTV, demand generation, pipeline economics and performance marketing.
Have built and led high-performing marketing teams.
Understand how AI is changing marketing—not just as a content tool, but as an operating model.
Have experience with AEO, answer-engine optimization or emerging AI-driven discovery.
Have managed high-volume email/SMS/lifecycle marketing programs.
Have experience with partner- and channel-led growth, particularly where relationships and networks drive distribution.
Can move comfortably between strategic positioning, creative thinking, data and unit economics.
Are comfortable making decisions, testing quickly and eliminating programs that aren't working.

Experience in fundraising, nonprofit organizations, community platforms or DTC eCommerce is a plus.

How We'll Measure Success

You'll be expected to build a measurable marketing organization with clear accountability for:

Growth
Qualified pipeline
Marketing-sourced and influenced revenue
MQL → SQL → Win conversion
Vertical expansion and launch performance
Efficiency
CAC and CAC payback
Channel performance
Marketing ROI
Experimentation velocity
Customer & Campaign Performance
Campaign engagement and conversion
Client campaign revenue and margins
Cost-to-serve
Automation and scalability
Brand & Market
Organic and branded traffic
AEO/AI discoverability
Share of voice in target markets
Supporter activation and recurring commerce

Why This Role Is Different

We're not looking for someone to inherit a large marketing organization and maintain the status quo.

We're looking for a builder.

Someone who can help define the market, create the strategy, build the team, establish the operating model and execute.

Someone who can sit in an executive meeting discussing market segmentation in the morning and review CAC, pipeline and campaign economics in the afternoon.

Someone who sees AI as an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how marketing works.

And someone who wants to have meaningful ownership in the outcome.

Compensation, Equity & Partnership

This is a founding-level executive opportunity.

The compensation package will include:

Competitive executive base compensation
Performance-based compensation tied to agreed business objectives
Meaningful equity participation
Full executive benefits

Because Inspire.World is at an important stage of growth and financing, compensation will be structured in phases, with cash compensation expected to increase following planned financing and achievement of agreed milestones.

The Ownership Opportunity

We're specifically interested in an entrepreneurial executive who wants to become a true long-term partner in Inspire.World.

The selected executive will have the opportunity to make a voluntary personal investment in the company alongside the founders and other senior leaders participating in the financing.

The investment would be a separate transaction and would not be a condition of employment. Investment terms, valuation, security and resulting ownership would be mutually agreed upon and documented separately.

Our goal is simple:

Build a leadership team of operators who are also owners.

If you're energized by the opportunity to help build a company—not simply run a department—we'd like to hear from you.

Location: Remote, U.S.
Travel: Leadership offsites, partner events and key industry conferences
Reports to: President

new_jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

Mid-Senior level

Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

new_jobs.title: Director, Performance Marketing -  Unannounced ARPG Mobile Game
new_jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director, Performance Marketing to join our Performance Marketing team to support a new, unannounced ARPG mobile game based on a major IP. This role is available on a hybrid basis in Los Angeles, CA, or remotely within the United States.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and aim to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating within the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

The Performance Marketing team is focused on driving player growth and efficiency across a diverse set of digital marketing channels. With teams across the US and Europe, the team operates in a fast-evolving mobile advertising ecosystem.

In this role, you will play a critical part in launching and scaling Scopely’s next major title, shaping user acquisition strategy from pre-launch testing through global scale.

The Director, Performance Marketing will lead global performance marketing strategy and execution for a new, unannounced ARPG mobile title based on a major IP. This role is responsible for driving player growth, building scalable acquisition strategies, optimizing multi-million-dollar budgets, and developing a high-performing performance marketing team across global markets.

What You Will Do

You will lead performance marketing efforts for a new, unannounced ARPG title based on a major IP, driving global user growth and building scalable acquisition strategies from pre-launch through live operations.
Own and lead global go-to-market performance marketing strategy and execution for the new title, from pre-launch testing through global scale.
Define and execute user acquisition strategies, methodologies, and processes to achieve growth and efficiency targets.
Partner with Product, Strategic Marketing, Growth, Finance, Analytics, Creative, and Data Engineering teams to align UA strategy with game positioning, audience targeting, lifecycle marketing, and business goals.
Build and scale acquisition programs across key channels, including Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs, ad networks, and emerging platforms.
Establish and optimize full-funnel measurement frameworks, including KPI definition, attribution strategy, incrementality testing, and LTV modeling.
Drive deep analytical insights into campaign performance, working with Analytics and Data Science to improve forecasting and decision-making.
Build and oversee Scopely’s UA pod in Shanghai, China.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of performance marketers, fostering accountability, innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate cross-functionally to enhance creative strategy, marketing technology, automation, and fraud prevention systems.
Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar marketing budgets with a focus on ROI and long-term player value.

What We’re Looking For

Fluent in English and Mandarin
Preferred experience working with Chinese gaming studios
Deep understanding of the Performance Marketing best practices on the Chinese gaming market
8+ years of performance marketing / user acquisition experience, ideally within mobile gaming or consumer apps
4+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams
Proven success managing and scaling multi-million dollar acquisition budgets across multiple channels
Strong experience with major platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic networks, etc.) Demonstrated expertise in go-to-market strategy, launch planning, and scaling new products
Deep analytical mindset with experience in attribution, incrementality testing, LTV modeling, and performance forecasting
Track record of driving significant growth through improvements in automation, marketing tech, or data infrastructure
Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Bonus: Experience in Midcore, RPG, Strategy 4x mobile games

Bonus Points

Experience working with Chinese gaming studios.
Deep understanding of performance marketing best practices in the Chinese gaming market.
Experience in midcore, RPG, or 4X strategy mobile games.

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone—and we believe the people behind our games should reflect that. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to thrive.

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range

$160,000—$230,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

:

The marketing and communications program led by the Director will embody and reflect the VMCVM’s core values, principles, strategic goals and priorities, and VMCVM’s unique attributes and offerings that contribute to the broader understanding of Virginia Tech.

In support of a successful marketing and communications program for VMCVM and the university, the Director will collaborate with and/or be a part of several teams, including the VMCVM’s Dean and senior leadership group; the VMCVM’s advancement team (including marketing and communications, alumni engagement and referring practitioner relations, and development); marketing and communications directors in other colleges and units across the university; and colleagues in the Advancement and Marketing and Communications divisions, among others. The Director collaborates with university leadership, faculty, staff, students, alumni, friends, grateful clients, and external partners to support marketing and communications initiatives.

Currently, the Director directly leads and supervises a team of four marketing and communications professionals, providing performance planning and evaluation, direction, support, and professional development opportunities. In addition, the Director works with VMCVM department heads and teaching hospital administration to align marketing and communications work to both VMCVM and university priorities.

Elements of a comprehensive and strategic marketing and communications program for VMCVM will include a wide range of tactics and strategies, including communications plans, news and feature stories, speeches for VMCVM leadership, message alignment, marketing campaigns, media relations and pitches, publications, photography and videography, social media, advertising, and similar items. Specific platforms include websites, news and information websites, email newsletters, and social media channels that support the VMCVM.

The Director will have a strong record of progressive experience in today's marketing and communications fields, including the development and implementation of a strategic, comprehensive marketing and communications program; evidence of strong communications, interpersonal, presentation, and marketing skills; and proficiency in using word processing, image processing, content management system, and social media tools. The ideal candidate will also have experience leading a team of marketing and communications professionals; a strong understanding of effective graphic design and branding principles and the use of the Internet as a medium of communication; and the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

This position supports VMCVM and university initiatives in Blacksburg, Roanoke, and the greater Washington, D.C. metro area, including the three teaching hospitals in Blacksburg, Roanoke, and Leesburg, Virginia. The Director is designated as emergency personnel.

The position is based at the Virginia Tech campus in Blacksburg, Virginia. The position reports to both the Senior Director of Marketing and Communications, Virginia Tech, and the Assistant Dean of Advancement of VMCVM.

new_jobs.title: Senior Content Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens has grown through referrals and relationships. Now we're building a content engine that earns attention beyond them. As our Senior Content Specialist, you'll be an early member of a small, growing marketing team, reporting to the Director of Marketing and working side by side with product marketing, events, marketing operations, and design.

You'll drive how Zipliens shows up in search engines (SERPs and AI platforms) and in the resources law firms rely on: our SEO strategy and baseline, website content, the LinkedIn content calendar, blog posts, customer newsletters, and case studies. Lien resolution is technical (Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation), and your job is to turn that complexity into content that paralegals, case managers, and attorneys actually find, use, and trust.

You'll thrive here if you love both the craft of a sharp draft and the discipline of keyword research and performance data, enjoy pulling insight out of subject-matter experts, solving industry pain points through creative mediums, and want to build a content program from the ground up. The role is primarily hands-on writing and execution, with growing ownership of strategy and planning as the program grows.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Build the SEO and content strategy

Establish an organic search baseline (traffic, impressions, rankings, branded vs. non-branded performance, top landing pages, backlinks, and technical health) before optimizing.
Partner with internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop and execute the keyword and topic strategy across lien resolution, Medicare, Medicaid, ERISA, medical liens, subrogation, settlement administration, and personal injury firm operations, balancing high-intent commercial terms with educational and long-tail searches.
Build and maintain the editorial/blog calendar, aligned to our ideal customer profile, product launches, and events.
Partner with marketing operations to connect organic visibility to qualified traffic, leads, and pipeline rather than traffic volume alone.

Create content that earns trust

Write and edit blog posts, guides, checklists, templates, FAQs, and reports that help personal injury law firm teams solve real lien resolution problems.
Partner with lien resolution SMEs, Customer Success, and company leadership to turn operational and regulatory knowledge into accurate, practical content.
Use Voice of the Customer (VOC) insights to develop customer case studies and spotlights that put proof behind our positioning, working with Product Marketing and Customer Success.
Support executive and employee thought leadership, including LinkedIn posts, bylines, and speaking abstracts.
Turn each strong source asset into multiple formats across channels.

Own website content and marketing collateral

Manage Zipliens’ public-facing resource center, partnering with subject matter experts to develop and publish content such as eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, infographics, etc.
Write and optimize website content, including service pages, landing pages, and metadata, in partnership with Product Marketing and Design.
Run on-page SEO/AEO and regular content refreshes, updating or consolidating underperforming pages.
Partner with marketing operations on calls to action, forms, and conversion paths so content connects to Sales.

Run channels and customer communications

Manage the LinkedIn content calendar, balancing core themes/pillars: thought leadership, brand awareness, campaign messaging, customer outcomes, employee advocacy, and event promotion.
Write and edit customer newsletter, nurture, and release-announcement copy, partnering with Customer Success, Product Marketing, and the team member building campaigns in HubSpot.
Create event content with the Events Manager, including pre-event promotion, session and speaker content, and post-event recaps.
Report on content performance regularly and recommend what to scale, update, or stop.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years in content marketing, SEO, or B2B content strategy, with a portfolio of published work.
Experience supporting organic traffic growth through SEO-driven content, and a solid understanding of how SEO strategy translates into rankings and conversions.
Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate technical or regulated topics into clear, accurate content.
Experience interviewing subject-matter experts and turning their input into finished content.
Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and repurposing while maintaining accuracy and brand voice.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and build process in a small team.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred

Hands-on experience with SEO and analytics tools (e.g., Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, or Ahrefs) and a CMS.
Experience in legal, legal tech, insurance, healthcare, or other complex or regulated B2B topics; familiarity with personal injury or lien resolution is a plus.
Experience with HubSpot (CMS, email, and reporting).
Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for team meetings, offsites, and select events.

new_jobs.title: FP&A Manager - Sales & Marketing and Revenue
new_jobs.description:
Description

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you will be the primary finance business partner for the Company's US Sales & Marketing organization, working closely with a wide range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access.

You will also oversee the Company's Gross-to-Net (GTN) revenue estimates and financial reporting. Most of the GTN modeling and data processing is outsourced to a specialized third-party provider (Integrichain / ICH); in this role, you will control, challenge, and validate the work performed by ICH rather than build or maintain the underlying models yourself.

Location
: Warren, New Jersey - minimum 3 days on site

Salary Range
: $140-160k

Key Responsibilities

FP&A / Business Partnering – Sales & Marketing (Priority #1):

Act as the lead finance business partner for US Sales & Marketing leadership, managing a wide range of stakeholders and moving parts across the organization.
Lead the annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning processes for Sales & Marketing expenses.
Analyze trends and variances against budget/forecast, provide decision-support indicators, and identify risks and opportunities across all partnered functions.
Support senior leaders (VP Sales, VP Marketing, and Market Access) on investments, projects, contracts, and resource allocation decisions.
Challenge business owners on their forecasts and planning assumptions; ensure spend discipline and visibility across a broad and evolving set of partners.
Actively participate in the monthly and quarterly financial closing process for the Sales & Marketing scope.

Revenue & Gross-to-Net (GTN) – Oversight & Control

Oversee and control the Gross-to-Net (GTN) estimates and deliverables prepared by the Company's outsourced GTN provider (Integrichain / ICH), rather than building or maintaining the GTN models directly.
Review and challenge ICH's monthly and quarterly GTN accruals (rebates, chargebacks, discounts, returns, Medicaid/Medicare/340B, distribution and prompt-pay fees) for completeness and accuracy.
Act as the main internal point of contact with ICH, ensuring deliverables are timely, well-documented, and aligned with contract terms and business assumptions.
Monitor GTN ratios and deductions as a percentage of gross sales, flagging unexpected trends or variances to Accounting and senior Finance leadership.
Ensure GTN estimates and revenue recognition are compliant with US GAAP (ASC 606) and support internal/external audit requests.

Contribution To Financial Reporting

Contribute to the preparation of US GAAP financial disclosures (10-Q, 10-K) related to revenue, GTN reserves, and Sales & Marketing expenses during quarterly and annual closings.
Prepare management reporting packages and Board/Executive Committee materials on commercial and revenue performance.

Continuous Improvement

Contribute to the enhancement and automation of Sales & Marketing and GTN reporting and planning tools.
Integrate non-financial KPIs into financial models and management reporting.
Improve existing processes to strengthen the reliability, timeliness, and relevance of financial information.

Ensure internal control procedures (SOX) are properly implemented and maintained within the scope

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration required; MBA, CPA, or CMA is a plus
Minimum 5–7 years of progressive FP&A or commercial finance experience, ideally within the biotech/pharmaceutical industry, including exposure to Sales & Marketing business partnering.

Behavioral skills :

A few years of experience as a manager (or senior analyst) within a Gross-to-Net (GTN) team is sufficient; deep GTN model-building expertise is not required, as most GTN activities are outsourced to a specialized third-party provider (Integrichain / ICH).
Experience managing or overseeing outsourced service providers / vendors is a plus.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with ERP/EPM systems (e.g., Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Hyperion) required.
Working knowledge of US GAAP revenue recognition (ASC 606) and the main components of Gross-to-Net (rebates, chargebacks, discounts, Medicaid/Medicare/340B), sufficient to control and challenge third-party deliverables.
This is a high-exposure role requiring strong business partnering capabilities, with direct interaction with a broad and evolving set of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access functions.
Rigor, autonomy, responsiveness, and the ability to operate in a demanding, fast-paced environment with many moving parts are essential.
Strong analytical skills, ability to prioritize, proactive mindset, synthesis skills, and intellectual curiosity are key to success in this role.
Curiosity: Keep on exploring uncharted territories. Always ask “why?” and more importantly “why not?”,
Courage: Take smart risks, mentor each other to always do better & be accountable for our choices, our opinions, and our actions,
Collaboration: Teamwork and spirit. Support each other and be equally involved in the achievement of our common goals,

Champion is an award-winning public relations and digital media agency specializing in food and beverage brands and franchise marketing. We are looking for a creative and organized Social Media Specialist with 1–2 years of experience to manage client social media accounts, develop content strategies, and support marketing campaigns. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys staying on top of trends, building client relationships, and bringing fresh ideas to a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Champion is a best-in-class, fully integrated marketing agency powered by a team of nearly 50 professionals who are experts in their respective fields and driven by a common purpose – to be an indispensable partner to our clients. We recognize that every brand is unique, requiring thoughtfully crafted programs designed to achieve both short- and long-term goals. Our clients know they will never get a “one size fits all” approach from their Champion team.

What You'll Own

Manage day-to-day social media activities across multiple client accounts, including more complex campaigns and client needs.
Lead routine client communications, including status calls, meeting agendas, project recaps, and performance updates.
Develop monthly content calendars and publishing strategies that align with each client's goals and brand.
Use audience insights and social media performance to recommend content ideas and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with PR, influencer, creative, paid media, and account teams to support integrated marketing campaigns.
Manage community engagement and social listening to monitor conversations, brand mentions, and audience sentiment.
Identify trending topics, platform updates, and real-time opportunities to increase engagement and brand visibility.
Present social media recommendations, campaign results, and new ideas to clients and internal teams.
Regularly bring forward creative ideas for leveraging current trends or developing new opportunities for client brands.
Track social media KPIs and turn performance data into actionable recommendations.
Mentor and guide interns, helping them build social media skills and prepare for future coordinator-level responsibilities.
Manage multiple campaigns and deadlines while maintaining high-quality work and consistent client communication.

What We're Looking For

1–2 years of experience in social media, digital marketing, public relations, communications, or a related field.
Experience managing social media accounts and developing content calendars.
Strong understanding of major social media platforms and their unique audiences, content formats, and best practices.
Ability to review analytics and use performance insights to recommend improvements.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence leading routine client discussions.
Good project management skills and the ability to balance multiple accounts, campaigns, and deadlines.
A creative mindset, with the ability to proactively bring new ideas and recommendations to the team.
Strong organizational skills, professionalism, and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively and take ownership of assigned client accounts and projects.
Interest in developing stronger strategic thinking and client management skills.

Nice to Have

Experience working in a public relations, digital marketing, advertising, or franchise marketing agency.
Experience managing multiple client accounts or supporting larger marketing campaigns.
Familiarity with social media scheduling, analytics, reporting, and social listening tools.
Exposure to influencer marketing, media relations, community management, or integrated campaigns.
Experience mentoring interns or supporting junior team members.
A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.

Why Champion

You'll work on brands people actually recognize and on campaigns where the results show up in a restaurant's sales the same week. Our digital practice is growing and new digital tools are being unlocked regularly. If you want to own accounts, go deep technically, and see your work move a business, this is that seat.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

new_jobs.title: Menswear Social Media Manager & Content Creator
new_jobs.description:
Social Media Manager & Content Creator

Location: Valley Stream, NY

Schedule: 4 days per week in office | 1 day WFH

Salary: $75,000 per year

About Twillory

Twillory makes clothes that feel like nothing: dress shirts, suits, blazers, polos and pants built from breathable, stretchy performance fabric. We started in menswear, and this month we’re launching our first women’s line. You’ll be building content for both from day one.

We sell mostly online, have two stores in the New York area, and we’re growing fast. We want our social to look like it.

The role

We’re hiring someone who lives on social and can make content that doesn’t look like an ad. You’ll come up with the idea, shoot it, edit it yourself and post it. No waiting on an agency or an editor.

This is an on-camera role. Menswear is most of our business, so a big part of the job is being the face of it: wearing and styling our men’s shirts, suits and pants on camera every week.

You’ll own Twillory’s organic presence on Instagram and TikTok, and the content you make will also run as paid ads. If a video works organically, we’ll put money behind it. You’ll work closely with our creative and paid media team.

What you’ll do

Be on camera in our menswear.
Model and style our men’s line in your own content most weeks: try-ons, fit checks, get-ready-with-me, outfit breakdowns. You’re the guy in the videos as much as the one making them.
Make content every week.
Shoot and edit short-form video (Reels, TikToks, Stories) and photo posts that feel native to the feed: styling videos, try-ons, day-in-the-life, trends, street interviews, behind the scenes in our stores and studio.
Edit it yourself.
Take raw footage to a finished post in CapCut, Premiere or similar. Cuts, captions, sound, pacing, text on screen.
Run our accounts.
Plan and keep the content calendar, post consistently, write captions, and handle comments and DMs with personality.
Know what’s happening on social.
Spot trends, sounds and formats early and turn them into Twillory content the same week, not the next month.
Show the clothes looking good.
Different outfits, different places, real guys. Make a dress shirt look as cool on your feed as it does on a person.
Feed our ads.
Hand off your best organic content for paid, and make variations (new hooks, new openings) when something works.
Work with creators.
Help brief and direct UGC creators and influencers, including for the women’s line.
Learn from the numbers.
Track views, saves, shares, follower growth and watch time. Double down on what’s working and kill what isn’t.
Cover launches and moments.
New products, sales, store events and the women’s line launch.

Who you are

You’re comfortable modeling menswear on camera and do it regularly, in your own content or for brands. Your portfolio should show it.
You’re on TikTok and Instagram more than anyone you know, and you can explain why a video blew up.
You have a portfolio of content you shot and edited yourself: a personal account, a brand you’ve worked with, or both. We want to see it.
You edit fast and well. You don’t need someone else to finish your videos.
You’ve grown an account, or a piece of content, and can tell us how.
You’re comfortable with a phone, a ring light and a mic, and you know how to make good lighting out of a window.
You care about style and have taste. You know what looks cool and what looks like a catalog.
You’re comfortable directing other people on camera.
You move quickly, take feedback well, and can manage your own calendar without being chased.
2–3 years making social content for a brand, creator or agency, or the equivalent body of your own work.

Bonus points

Fashion, menswear or DTC ecommerce experience
You’ve made content that ran as a paid ad and know what makes an ad stop the scroll
Photography skills
Experience working with UGC creators or influencers
Comfortable with Adobe Premiere, After Effects or Lightroom on top of CapCut

How to apply:

Send your resume and links to 3–5 pieces of content you shot and edited yourself, including at least one where you’re on camera wearing menswear. Tell us in a sentence or two which one performed best and why you think it worked.

new_jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

new_jobs.description:
THE BIGGEST NAME IN HOME. THE BOLDEST TEAM IN E-COMMERCE.

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself. Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you've shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there's a good chance you've already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud. We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day. It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.

To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

About the Role:

Ashley Digital is looking for a Video Editor, Growth Marketing to join our in-house Growth team, reporting to the Senior Designer, Growth Marketing. This hybrid role is for a creative who loves seeing their work move the numbers, whether it's a video cut or a static image. You'll edit raw footage and existing content into scroll-stopping, conversion-driven ads for paid social, YouTube, and CTV, while also concepting new ideas, designing static image ads, and iterating on existing creative to make it stronger and more effective. You'll use performance data to make each next version even better. Your work will reach millions of customers every day, and you'll help shape new creative ideas alongside Marketing Directors, Growth Platform Leads, and fellow designers.

What You'll Be Doing:

Edit and repurpose video in Premiere for paid social, YouTube, and CTV, testing hooks, ad bodies, and footage combinations to find what performs best
Build and organize workflows for daily and weekly creative needs
Bring new concepts to the table and strengthen existing creative based on what the data shows
Design net-new static ads in Figma for promotional and evergreen campaigns
Partner with the growth team to brainstorm and execute rapid creative iterations, driving continuous testing and optimization
Stay current on industry trends, competitor creative, and best practices in digital advertising
Push visual boundaries while keeping the work true to the Ashley brand

The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law.

What You Bring:

2–5 years of video editing and design experience, with a portfolio of performance-driven creative for digital campaigns
Strong short-form editing skills in Adobe, Premiere, CapCut, or AI creative tools like Firefly
Thorough knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) and Figma
Experience tracking performance metrics like CTR and hook rate, and running creative testing cadences
Comfort balancing speed, quality, and performance in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
Excellent time management, communication, and collaboration skills
