new_jobs.title: Brand & Trade Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
About Greta Group

Greta Group is a family-owned multinational founded in Argentina in 1977, dedicated to the representation, import and distribution of premium fragrances, cosmetics and hair care. Greta US & Caribbean, based in Miami, is the group's youngest affiliate, serving the Caribbean and Travel Retail Americas, cruise lines included.

The role

You'll join Greta Group working side by side with the General Manager, owning the execution of trade marketing across the Caribbean and Travel Retail Americas.

What you'll do

Trade Marketing & Education
• Execute events, animations, window displays and in-store visuals at the point of sale.
• Purchase POS materials per budget and assemble kits for each client
• Run incentive programs for beauty advisors.
• Coordinate and deliver brand trainings, mostly in English.

Commercial & Account Management
• Prepare the sales and A&P budgets.
• Build launch proposals and presentations for brands and retailers
• Manage retail relationships: sell-in targets, stock rotation, client needs and competitive analysis.
• Report sell-in, process sell-out and follow up on pricing, offers and assortments.

Data & Reporting
• Create SKUs for new references, launches and sets.
• Keep clients up to date with the brands' digital and social media content.
• Report on point-of-sale actions and consolidate campaign and event recaps.

What we're looking for

• 1–3 years in marketing, trade marketing or commercial support. Beauty or travel retail experience is a plus.
• Fully bilingual English / Spanish, written and spoken.
• Willing to travel across the Caribbean and the Americas.
• Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
• Organized, proactive and eager to grow with the company.
• Authorized to work in the U.S. and based in Miami, FL.

Why Greta

• Real ownership from day one in a growing operation.
• Direct exposure to world-class beauty brands and the travel retail channel.
• A defined development path.

Greta US & Caribbean is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About Sumeru Sumeru is a leading global IT and marketing consulting services company headquartered in Los Angeles. We turn bold ideas into impact through strategy rooted in customer insight, fueled by innovation and technology. Our vision is to help brands earn a lasting place in their customers' hearts by personalizing every experience in real time.
In our Digital Customer Experience practice, agency and technology teams work side by side, bringing strategy, creative, technology and analytics under one roof so clients work with a single partner. Our strategists and creatives lead omnichannel, campaign and content strategy and experience design, using data and AI to personalize at scale. We serve clients across industries, from healthcare and education to retail and finance, and measure success by business results.
We partner with Salesforce, SAP, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and ServiceNow. Our inclusive culture is built on curiosity, commitment, joy, belonging and awareness, and on the belief that human excellence guided by good intentions creates real impact.

Your impact As lead strategist on a Fortune 100 healthcare client's omnichannel engagement program, you'll own the strategy and be accountable for its performance, driving acquisition, retention and lifetime value across email, SMS, app, web and landing pages.
You'll help the client deliver personalized, real-time engagement across channels and connect customer journeys and data across systems, so every interaction moves the business forward.

Who you'll work with You'll join Sumeru's Digital Customer Experience practice in Los Angeles, working within the client-facing front-end team of strategy and creative. You'll own the strategy and ensure the creative delivers on it, collaborating closely with our marketing technology, CRM and analytics teams and the client's brand, digital and medical/legal/regulatory stakeholders.

What you'll do Strategy and client partnership

•     Serve as a primary strategic counterpart to the client, from brand managers to director-level stakeholders, and lead strategy workshops on site and remote.
•     Build the annual omnichannel roadmap with clear KPIs, in partnership with Sumeru's account manager.
•     Align each project strategy with Sumeru's account manager before presenting it to client stakeholders for approval.
Customer experience and journeys

•     Own the end-to-end customer messaging strategy across lifecycle, transactional and engagement communications, so every interaction is timely, personalized, compliant and aligned to business outcomes.
•     Design lifecycle journeys from acquisition and onboarding through retention, grounded in journey mapping, personas and segmentation.
•     Define personalization strategy with the CRM and data analytics teams: tailored content, next-best-action and offers by segment.
Campaign strategy and creative alignment

•     Own campaign strategy and content strategy for unified omnichannel campaigns across email, SMS, app, web and landing pages, and partner with the marketing technology team on channel-level implementation.
•     Translate campaign strategy into clear content and creative briefs, review creative work against the brief and client feedback, and confirm it's aligned with the strategy before client presentation.
•     Steer work through the client's medical/legal/regulatory review without losing pace or quality.
Measurement and optimization

•     Define KPIs with the analytics team and use reporting and attribution insights to drive optimization that continuously improves engagement, conversion and ROI.
•     Run a structured testing program and act on audit findings across targeting, messaging, creative and cadence.
•     Present performance and recommendations to client stakeholders, and bring the client new ideas from emerging martech and AI trends.

What you bring •     6+ years in digital marketing strategy, with at least 3 years as lead strategist on enterprise accounts.
•     Strategy ownership on a Fortune 500 or comparable enterprise account, including presenting to senior client stakeholders.
•     Proven omnichannel and lifecycle CRM work across email, SMS, app and web, with retention or LTV results you can quantify.
•     Hands-on expertise in customer journey mapping, customer marketing maturity assessment, omnichannel marketing, personalization, measurement and ROI, and contextual marketing.
•     Ability to translate strategy into clear requirements for technology and analytics teams, with working knowledge of marketing automation, CRM, first-party data and privacy-compliant personalization.
•     Excellent written and spoken English, strong copy judgment and a sharp eye for design quality, backed by a bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have •     Experience in a regulated industry, ideally healthcare, pharma or medical device, including work through compliance or medical/legal/regulatory review.
•     Familiarity with HIPAA and patient-data privacy as they apply to CRM marketing.
•     Experience with an enterprise marketing automation platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe or Braze.
•     Experience applying AI to personalization, content production or analytics.
•     Agency background on enterprise accounts.

What success looks like •      First 90 days:
you know the account's key strategies and the program's journeys, KPIs and stakeholders, and have delivered an audit with prioritized recommendations.
•      First 6 months:
you lead strategy on assigned campaigns and secure client approval on schedule.
•      First year:
acquisition, retention and engagement KPIs have measurably improved, and the testing program produces learnings that shape the next year's plan.

Your growth and benefits You'll gain senior client exposure on a Fortune 100 account, with room to expand your scope as the account grows. Sumeru invests in professional growth and development at every level.
•     A benefits package, including health coverage and paid time off
•     Access to current martech and AI tools
•     Collaboration with diverse, talented teams

Equal opportunity Sumeru is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act.

new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a driven, creative, and results-oriented Marketing Associate to join our team in St. Louis, MO. The ideal candidate has a strong background in sports, a passion for marketing, and the ability to turn big-picture visions into impactful campaigns. This individual will bring strong leadership, exceptional teamwork, sound executive decision-making, and outstanding account management skills to a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

As a Marketing Associate, you will work closely with internal teams, clients, and key stakeholders to develop and execute strategic marketing initiatives that drive engagement, strengthen brand identity, and deliver measurable results. The right candidate is a proactive problem-solver who can build relationships, manage multiple priorities, and bring sales campaigns to life.

Marketing Associate Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with team members and clients to develop, coordinate, and execute creative marketing campaigns aligned with strategic objectives.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, manage account needs, communicate effectively, and ensure projects meet expectations and deadlines.
Apply skills from sports experience including: customer engagement, team culture, and brand partnerships to create compelling marketing opportunities.
Take initiative, contribute innovative ideas, support team success, and help guide projects from concept through execution.
Evaluate opportunities, process sales, prioritize competing demands, and make informed decisions that support business and campaign objectives.
Work with sales, marketing, and other internal teams to align priorities and bring campaign visions to life.
Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and resources while maintaining organization, attention to detail, and accountability.
Monitor sales campaign performance, gather insights, and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and client satisfaction.

Marketing Associate Key Qualifications:
A strong background in sports, sports marketing, athletics is a plus
Excellent leadership skills and the ability to motivate, influence, and collaborate with diverse teams.
Strong executive-level judgment, critical-thinking abilities, and confident decision-making skills.
Proven ability to manage accounts, build client relationships, and communicate professionally with stakeholders.
A collaborative mindset with the ability to translate client ideas and creative visions into actionable marketing strategies.
Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines.
A proactive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented approach to challenges.
A passion for creative strategy, brand development, relationship building, and delivering results.

The Marketing Associate is someone who understands the competitive, team-driven nature of sports and knows how to apply that mindset to marketing. In this position, you will be taking ownership, making thoughtful decisions, building trust with clients, and bringing people together around a shared vision. You balance creativity with strategic thinking and can move seamlessly between driving sales, managing relationships, and executing campaigns. Most importantly, you are a team player with a leader's mindset who thrives on collaboration, values accountability, and is motivated to make an impact.

Why Join the Arch Events Team?
This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful sales initiatives, develop strong client partnerships, collaborate with talented professionals, and help transform creative ideas into successful campaigns. You will have the opportunity to grow your marketing expertise, strengthen your leadership skills, and make a tangible impact in a dynamic

Ready to combine your passion for sports, strategic thinking, and relationship-building skills to bring great marketing ideas to life? We encourage you to submit your resumé today!

Arch Events is an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.title: Product Marketing Senior Manager
new_jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing…

As a Product Marketing Senior Manager, you will provide support for Verizon Business Group’s Advanced Solutions product portfolio. This portfolio is designed to provide high-performance network solutions to support the connectivity and applications our customers are implementing globally. Within the marketing organization, you’ll act as the single point of contact and subject matter expert for products within the Advanced Solutions portfolio and assist with strategy formulation, collateral creation, review, and any other needed activities to support the success of the product set.

Additionally, you will also serve as the product and portfolio marketing lead working with the Product Management organization. You will be responsible in partnership and collaboration with product, segment marketing, sales, and solutions architects to develop product/portfolio value proposition, customer outcome/benefits, VBG’s market differentiation, and the channel and digital activation strategy.

Leveraging market data and insights, Verizon base customer and prospect analytics, customer persona types and other information to develop the appropriate launch strategy for new and existing products.
Partnering with Product Management, Sales, Sales Architects, Sales Operations, Field Marketing, Go-to-Market, and other marketing partners.
Playing a central role in strengthening our brand and executing on our product marketing plans by conducting independent marketing research, developing marketing plans, and creating high quality customer collateral and product assets, using segmented value propositions.
Developing compelling, differentiated positioning to accelerate revenues and bookings for our products.
Developing and executing marketing strategies to drive growth and retention across Global Enterprise, Public Sector, and Business Markets.
Strengthening our brand, defending revenues, and driving new sales by developing marketing strategies with compelling and differentiated positioning to accelerate revenues and bookings.
Collaborating with partner teams to promote cross sell/upsell opportunities and reinforce cross-portfolio messaging to ensure sales motion includes selling comprehensive solutions to build loyalty.
Overseeing project management related to product launches and other marketing activities with the goal of accelerating revenue and improving services to our customers as well as results for Verizon.

What We’re Looking For...

You are a highly collaborative, innovative, and strategic thinker with a deep understanding of wireline and wireless networks. You are equally comfortable leading teams focused on strategy and teams focused on execution and project delivery. You are an expert communicator who can deliver a message across stakeholder teams.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Product Marketing/Strategy experience using market research and/ or data analytics.
Experience with Marketing collateral and/or Sales Enablement creation and execution.
Willingness to travel.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

A Master’s degree.
Product lifecycle and/ or product placement experience.
Strategic consulting with a business development and marketing focus.
Experience using AI tools.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, communication, negotiating, and relationship-building skills.
Experience with wireline connectivity products and understanding of voice connectivity solutions and strategic connectivity products (network connectivity products).
Experience with AI tools.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $105,000.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $115,500.00 - $201,000.00.

new_jobs.title: High-Ticket Marketing Lead
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Amazon Leo are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own audience management, segmentation, and activation across Amazon Leo's global marketing engine. This role is the primary owner of audience management and systems, managing access, governance standards, and seamless activation across channels. You will enable Marketing, Product, and Leadership teams to reach the right customers with the right messages at the right time.

This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on administration. You will own and evolve audience management systems—primarily our Customer Data (Treasure Data)—and across our marketing tech stack, building upon existing foundations as new data sources, channels, and use cases emerge. You will design and maintain audience infrastructure, activation workflows, and governance standards, partnering with Marketing Operations, cross-functional marketing teams, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Marketing Automation teams to ensure accurate, actionable audiences across the full customer journey. As Amazon Leo's marketing expands globally, you will evolve audience capabilities to support new markets, channels, and customer segments, while managing health, roadmap prioritization, and scalability requirements.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end audience management strategy for Amazon Leo marketing across B2B, B2C, and B2G customer segments
Serve as the primary administrator and expert for the Amazon Leo Customer Data (Treasure Data), including data model design, identity resolution strategies, audience activation workflows, and optimization
Build self-service audience segmentation capabilities and empower marketing teams to independently create and activate audiences through training, documentation, and scalable processes
Design and maintain audience taxonomy, naming conventions, and governance standards while ensuring data quality and privacy compliance
Translate complex marketing campaign requirements into technical audience definitions, segmentation logic, and activation workflows across marketing automation (Braze, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager)
Create comprehensive documentation, deliver training sessions, and build enablement resources that reduce dependency on technical teams for routine audience creation
Own the audience management roadmap, prioritizing feature requests and enhancements in partnership with Marketing, Data Engineering, and Product teams
Monitor audience performance metrics, conduct deep-dive analysis, and provide recommendations for optimization and refinement

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

You will spend part of your day improving the audience management architecture—designing better segments, refining activation workflows, and enabling new use cases in the CDP and marketing automation. Another part of your day will involve partnering with Marketing teams to translate campaign requirements into audience definitions or troubleshoot activation issues. You will also work directly with Data Engineering and BI teams to validate data quality and ensure measurement accuracy. You might conduct a training session for new marketing team members on audience segmentation best practices, or update documentation to reflect new capabilities. You will be a strategic and technical owner ensuring that Amazon Leo Marketing can reach the right audiences with precision and scale.

About The Team

The Amazon Leo Marketing team is responsible for building a world-class brand and driving global demand for a transformational connectivity service. The Marketing Ops & Analytics team builds the systems, data flows, measurements, and insights that support a multi-LOB global business. We operate with the agility of a startup inside Amazon, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Science, and global marketing teams to ensure our decisions are grounded in high-quality data.

4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
Experience managing and measuring marketing performance in various channels

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing external partners to develop marketing programs
Experience presenting ideas to various levels of an organization to gain support for initiatives

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Strong understanding of marketing performance metrics, lead funnels, campaign attribution, customer engagement, and business development pipeline reporting.
Ability to synthesize large amounts of data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to actively listen, ask thoughtful questions, explain technical information clearly, and develop executive-ready presentations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to work through complex issues from identification to resolution.

About The Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Our newsletter and email program is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Newsletter & Email Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. If you have run a monetized newsletter program at scale—this is the role for you. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work: building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume newsletter program of 40+ campaigns per week, along with automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization and Partner Performance

Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns-from planning through send and post-send analysis.
Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets - IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops - monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys-activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back-to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub's own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle - including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation - and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

9+ years of hands-on email marketing in a high-volume program, including at least 7 years running a newsletter or email program monetized through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
Experience programming reoccurring newsletters: maintaining send and inventory calendar while balancing paid placements with member experience.
Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack — our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics — across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.

Description

The Amazon Leo team is on a mission to create a connected world that will usher in a new era of global productivity and prosperity. Through a constellation of satellites in low earth orbit, we’re going to bring fast Internet to every individual, household, school, and business to empower everyone to collaborate, work, play, invent, and learn from any location, at any time, on any device.

Amazon Leo’s Americas B2B marketing team is looking for an exceptionally talented and passionate individual to create awareness and generate sales-ready leads in the enterprise by leveraging inbound and outbound marketing plays. This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact within an emerging business (and long-term bet) within Amazon.

The ideal candidate is a B2B demand generation expert with deep experience running account-based marketing programs and coordinating inbound and outbound plays against named enterprise accounts. You have worked a target account list with a field sales team, understand how buying committees form in large organizations, and know how to build pipeline in long-cycle, high-consideration deals.

To be successful in this role, you will need to develop vertical expertise across Leo’s priority enterprise industries to produce account-specific campaigns, and partner closely with field sellers, SDRs, and Central Marketing to deliver coordinated insight-driven campaigns that move buying committees from awareness to sales-ready engagement.

Key job responsibilities

Enterprise Demand Generation & ABM

Own and execute Leo’s North America enterprise ABM motion, orchestrating targeted account plays across inbound and outbound channels to build pipeline within named accounts across priority verticals, partnering closely with field sellers and SDRs to coordinate account buying committee engagement, and to automate sales handoff.
Develop and manage integrated campaign calendars aligned to Leo’s enterprise GTM milestones, service availability expansions, key industry events, and EBC programming—ensuring marketing plays are sequenced to amplify field sales moments rather than run in parallel.
Build and manage enterprise nurture programs in Marketo that move engaged accounts from awareness to sales-ready status, including vertical-specific nurture tracks, EBC follow-up sequences, and post-event re-engagement, all with clearly defined MQA thresholds and handoff criteria co-developed with sales.
Serve as the connective tissue between marketing and the enterprise field sales team to align campaign calendars to account pursuit timelines, co-developing vertical-specific messaging and outbound sequences with SDRs, and ensuring marketing investment is concentrated on accounts where sales is actively engaged.
Drive inbound demand capture by briefing and directing Central Marketing channel owners on Leo’s enterprise targeting inputs (account lists, vertical personas, intent signals) to activate paid social (LinkedIn), content syndication, SEM, programmatic display, and webinar programs against named account clusters and buying committees.

Scale Impact Through AI and Intelligent Automation

Design and deploy AI-powered workflows that operationalize Leo's ABM motion at scale, from intent signal ingestion and account prioritization to personalized content assembly and campaign activation across target verticals.
Use AI agents to compress the time between insight and action: automate account research, buying committee mapping, and outbound sequence personalization so sellers and marketers spend time on high-judgment work, not repeatable tasks.
Treat Leo's marketing stack like a high-performance engine: frequently instrument, test, tune, and examine the components (Demandbase, MAP, CRM, generative AI) to increase account coverage and pipeline velocity through intelligent tooling.
Document and codify what works so that ABM plays, agent workflows, and campaign frameworks become repeatable infrastructure the broader Leo marketing team can build on globally.

Measurement & Reporting

Define and own the enterprise demand gen measurement framework anchored on Marketing Qualified Accounts (MQAs), influenced pipeline value, account coverage by tier and vertical, and pipeline velocity, then run structured experiments to continuously improve program performance, giving leadership a clear view of what’s working and where to invest next.
Build and maintain an enterprise demand gen performance dashboard that connects account-level campaign activity to pipeline outcomes, translating raw data into actionable insights for field sales, SDR leadership, and the broader North America marketing team.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience communicating results to senior leadership
6+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or account-based marketing, with at least 2 years operating in an enterprise GTM motion with a field sales team and named account targets.
Understanding of enterprise ABM mechanics and the tools that support them (like Demandbase), intent signal interpretation, account scoring, and buying committee mapping, well enough to brief, direct, and optimize program performance even when not directly instrumenting every tool.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work across account-level data sources (Salesforce, MAP dashboards) to surface account engagement signals, measure pipeline influence, and make data-driven program decisions.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred) for building and managing enterprise nurture programs, including vertical-specific email sequences, decision-tree logic, account-level scoring thresholds, and MQA handoff triggers integrated with Salesforce.
Demonstrated ability to define enterprise demand gen KPIs (MQAs, account coverage, pipeline influence, velocity), interpret multi-touch attribution data, and translate program performance into actionable recommendations for both marketing and sales leadership.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write compelling campaign briefs, creative direction, and executive-ready performance summaries.
Experience marketing to enterprise or strategic accounts in satellite, telecommunications, broadband, cloud infrastructure, or industrial technology market segments, with familiarity with the operational and procurement complexity of large organizational buyers.
Experience working in both a hyperscaler business and an early-stage (launch-phase) business where strategy is actively being built rather than inherited.
Proven ability to communicate performance results and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.

new_jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Marketing Cloud Next is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

This role specializes in guiding organizations through seamless migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms—including Granicus GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement —to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. By identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, the CSM strategically aligns solutions with the customer’s top priorities, projects, and goals.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Core Technical Skills Required

Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform. Able to architect solutions end-to-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to Marketing Cloud Next — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect’s technical approach.
Subscriber Data Model & Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement ) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to Marketing Cloud Next equivalents.
Journey & Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and priortize complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Flow native design patterns.
Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post-migration deliverability strategy.
Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API-triggered sends and event-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA’s implementation approach.
Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end-to-end Marketing Cloud Next solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
Workshop Facilitation & Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory’s MDLC wave delivery model.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
AI Engagement Monitoring: Use AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
Collaborative Learning: Actively seek out Agentblazer training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnostic questions, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields.
Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
Possesses industry-relevant expertise and is actively honing skills in a relevant functional area, with an understanding of the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
Actively seeks out relevant learning activities, approaches obstacles as growth opportunities, and seeks experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.
Position requirements: Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. Company visa sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Cloud/Platform Requirements (included With The Above)

3+ years of experience supporting customers using Marketing Cloud Next or Legacy Marketing Platform knowledge
Marketing Cloud Next - Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform - Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Mobile Studio, Advertising Studio and Contact Builder
Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement )

Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud

3+ years of experience in A/E/C marketing or business development

new_jobs.description:
Marketing Specialist - SEO, Content & Growth

Ironclad Property Management | Connecticut Market | Full-Time | Remote

We’re a U.S.-based property management company serving property owners across Connecticut, and we’re looking for a creative, motivated marketing specialist who’s ready to take ownership of our marketing and help us grow, all in a remote role.
We’re not looking for an agency or someone who just checks off tasks. We want someone who’ll become part of our team, understand our business and the Connecticut real estate market, bring fresh ideas, and turn them into marketing strategies that help us attract and sign more property owners. Basically, someone who doesn’t just make plans but actually makes things happen.

What You’ll Do

Take ownership of our marketing efforts, evaluate what’s working, identify opportunities, and build a clear growth strategy.
Research the Connecticut real estate and property management market to understand our audience, competitors, and what makes property owners choose a management company.
Plan, create, and execute marketing campaigns that generate leads and turn them into new clients.
Lead our SEO and content strategy, from keyword research and blog content to website optimization and improving search visibility.
Use data, analytics, and a little creativity to figure out what’s working, what isn’t, and what we should try next.
Work closely with the team to bring ideas to life across our website, social media, and other marketing channels.

What We’re Looking For

Real marketing experience and the ability to take a project from idea to execution.
Strong SEO, content marketing, and strategic thinking skills.
Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken. You’ll be working closely with our team so being able to communicate clearly and confidently is a must.
A proactive, enthusiastic mindset. You don’t wait for someone to tell you every next step, you take initiative, solve problems, and look for ways to improve.
Someone creative, organized, comfortable with feedback, and genuinely excited to help a business grow.

Bonus points if you have experience with
local SEO, property management or investor marketing, WordPress/Webflow, Google Analytics, Search Console, or GoHighLevel.

A Few Things to Know

This is a full-time, remote position where you’ll work directly with the Ironclad team. We’re looking for someone committed to working with us, not an agency managing multiple clients.

If you’re excited about building something, testing ideas, and seeing your work turn into real business growth, we’d love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Category Marketing, AWS Cross Category Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS is seeking a Senior Manager to lead the Cross-Category Services marketing team. This role owns the marketing strategy and execution for a portfolio of services that help AWS customers accelerate their cloud transformations and achieve long-term success: AWS Training & Certification, AWS Support, AWS Professional Services, and AWS Marketplace & Partner Services.

These services represent a critical part of the AWS customer journey — from building skills and getting expert guidance, to finding and deploying third-party solutions, to ensuring ongoing operational excellence. Together they generate billions in revenue.

As the leader of this team, you will build and manage a high-performing team of product marketers, develop differentiated positioning and messaging for each portfolio, drive customer insights that inform marketing strategy, and serve as the connective tissue between diverse business stakeholders who have different operating rhythms, go-to-market motions, and customer audiences.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complexity — someone who can context-switch fluidly across businesses while maintaining strategic coherence, who builds trust with senior stakeholders through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery.

Key job responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop and own the marketing strategy for Training & Certification, Support, Professional Services, and Marketplace — including positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market plans
Synthesize customer insights, market data, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and shape strategy across all four businesses
Drive differentiated messaging that connects each service to the broader AWS customer success narrative — helping customers understand how these services accelerate transformation
Lead product launch strategies and associated plans, including naming, target audience definition, content development, and marketing vehicle selection
Continuously measure and optimize marketing performance, establishing KPIs and mechanisms for each portfolio

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the primary marketing partner to four distinct business leadership teams, each with different operating rhythms, customer segments, and go-to-market motions
Build deep trust with VP and Director-level stakeholders across product, sales, professional services, and partner organizations through intellectual rigor and consistent delivery
Navigate competing priorities and resource constraints across portfolios — making principled trade-off decisions and communicating them transparently

People Management & Team Building

Build, lead, and develop a team of product and general marketing professionals spanning multiple portfolios and locations
Hire, retain, and grow top marketing talent
Resource the team effectively across portfolios, making staffing recommendations aligned to business priority and impact

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience managing teams
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of B2B procurement processes
Experience working with executive leadership in large organizations

new_jobs.description:
About

Bloomingdale’s makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire our customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. We will always strive to make Bloomingdale’s like no other store in the world. Across all brand touchpoints—from Bloomingdales.com to our newest small store concept, Bloomie’s—everyone plays a critical role bringing our mission to life. Our inclusive culture promotes diversity of background, thought and opinion. Regardless of position, we believe all colleagues have a voice and access to share their thoughts with every level of leadership. Our colleagues are passionate, driven, entrepreneurial and collaborative, while having a lot of fun along the way.

Job Overview

The Marketing and Special Events Coordinator assists in the execution of Bloomingdale’s Integrated Marketing campaigns through in-store events and activations. This colleague has involvement with their internal store partners and vendor partners, as well as external community partners and organizations to drive brand awareness and customer acquisition to positively impact market share on a localized level. The Coordinator will play a critical role in representing the Bloomingdale’s brand in a positive, professional way that enhances our company’s reputation and promotes our business objectives.

Essential Functions

Pursues localized opportunities in alignment with Marketing and Special Events Senior Manager and store leadership to cultivate customers and build sales. Supports local accelerated growth of priority businesses with event intensification that builds store animation and experience.
Assists in the planning and full execution of all aspects of in-store events and animation that support the direction of the Central and local strategy. Track post-event result, share photos, and provide feedback to Central partners.
Enhances Central event strategy by supporting with local secured sponsorships, co-branding opportunities and/or community initiatives that build productive local relationships with the intent to build loyal customer base, acquire new clients and drive commerce.
Partners with the Store Leadership team in creating curated event experiences to build loyalty and share among Bloomingdale’s top spending Luxe, Unlocked and Top of the List (TOL) clients. Partner with local client teams to monitors frequency of visits, engagement and spend as it relates to engagement with eventing.
Collaborates with the Central Earned Media team to enhance any local media plans, securing publicity and partnering with brand-appropriate social media influencers and bloggers.
Guides General Manager(s) as to productive involvement in outside organizations and events.
Leverages corporate philanthropy giving programs to maximize community impact and fundraising.
May be called upon as point person for external communication locally.

Qualifications

1-2 years direct experience
Practices open and continuous communication, values keeping others informed, exemplary organization, attention to detail, and effectively presenting information in a clear, concise manner.
Excellent leadership, facilitation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across functional lines and at many levels.
Hybrid work model that includes in-store (4 days) and remote work ( 1 day) requirements
Ability to work a flexible schedule based on event calendar and Company needs.
This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

new_jobs.description:
Blacksmith Agency

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency is scaling its marketing division to support a growing portfolio of PPC and SEO clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As SEO (Search Engine Optimization) Manager at Blacksmith, you own strategy, performance and client-facing leadership across paid search, paid social, SEO and conversion optimization.

This is a hybrid strategic and operational role. You join sales calls to shape strategy, oversee internal and external specialists, build performance roadmaps and make sure client campaigns deliver measurable outcomes. You own results, reporting, QA and continual improvement. It is a senior seat that blends analytical depth, strong communication and execution oversight.

What You Will Own

Lead strategy for all PPC and SEO clients across multiple industries.
Join sales calls with account executives to validate scope, pitch technical recommendations and help close deals.
Build 90 day, 6 month and annual growth roadmaps for every client.
Own client performance across Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft and organic search.
Audit PPC campaigns, keyword strategies, bidding structures, landing pages and CRO opportunities.
Oversee technical SEO, on-page SEO, link building, programmatic pages and AI-driven content.
Own KPI tracking, conversion attribution and analytics accuracy.
Give weekly direction and QA, and coordinate priorities with the marketing project manager.
Present monthly and quarterly performance summaries to clients.

What You Bring

4 to 7 years in PPC, SEO or multi-channel full-funnel strategy.
Strong experience running paid and organic channels at the same time.
Expertise with Google Ads, GA4, Google Search Console, keyword research tools and paid media optimization.
Ability to build and articulate strategic recommendations for clients and account executives.
A track record of overseeing execution teams and managing deliverable quality.
Sharp analytical skills and the ability to diagnose performance issues fast.

Nice to have

Agency experience managing multiple clients at once.
Experience joining sales calls and influencing close rates.
Familiarity with multifamily, real estate or high-intent lead generation.
Experience with AI SEO, programmatic SEO, technical SEO audits and CRO.

People who think strategically and manage execution.
People who simplify complex marketing ideas for clients.
People who own results and take full accountability.
People who work well with distributed teams.
People who enjoy building rather than inheriting polished systems.
